entries.m: 十方三世一切如来全身舍利宝塔 唐·特进试鸿胪卿大兴善寺三藏沙门大广智不空 奉诏译 《一切如来心秘密全身舍利宝箧印陀罗尼经》(t19n1022a) 三大咒塔核心陀罗尼之一。经云若书写此经置塔中,即为一切如来金刚藏窣堵波,十方诸佛常来加持。杭州雷峰塔(吴越王钱俶造八万四千铜塔)出土原刻本即为此咒。本词条直接关联下载自 cbeta 官方库之《t19n1022a.xml》原典。

entries.m: 释迦牟尼佛顶化佛 / 大白伞盖佛母 (usnisa-sitatapatra) 唐·中天竺沙门般剌蜜帝 译 / 唐·不空 译《大白伞盖陀罗尼经》 《大佛顶如来密因修证了义诸菩萨万行首楞严经》卷七 (t19n0945) 暨 gretil 梵本《sitatapatra》(bsu004_u.htm) 「咒中之王」大佛顶首楞严神咒五会全本核心(第一会毗卢真法会、第二会释尊应化会、第三会观音合同会、第四会金刚藏折摄会、第五会文殊弘传会暨五大心咒与根本咒心)。佛顶放百宝无畏光明,光中化佛宣说此咒,十方如来依此咒心成无上正遍知觉、降伏诸魔、制诸外道、拔济阿难免摩登伽难。直接对勘 cbeta《t19n0945.xml》卷七、房山石经《f28n1071》与德国哥廷根大学 gretil 梵文原典《bsu004_u.htm (sitatapatra)》。

entries.m: 毗卢遮那如来(大日如来)暨不空罥索观音 唐·大兴善寺三藏沙门大广智不空 奉诏译 《不空罥索毗卢遮那佛大灌顶光真言》(t19n1002) 暨《不空罥索神变真言经》(t20n1092) 东密与唐密最尊崇之超度、灭罪、放光加持真言,根本咒共 23 个悉昙梵字。经云若有众生造十恶五逆四重诸罪,闻此大灌顶光真言二三七遍,或以土沙加持散亡者尸骸墓上,立得光明及身,除诸罪报,莲华化生西方极乐世界。本词条完整接入从 cbeta 官方库下载之《t19n1002.xml》全部 23 个原典悉昙梵字与《不空罥索经》归敬及随心咒。

entries.m: 般若佛母 (bhagavati-prajnaparamita) & 观自在菩萨 (唐)玄奘 译 · 爱德华·孔泽(edward conze 1967)梵本《prajnaparamitahrdayasutra》与法隆寺贝叶本对勘 《般若波罗蜜多心经》(t08n0251) / gretil prajnhsu.htm 三世诸佛依般若波罗蜜多故,得阿耨多罗三藐三菩提。心经末后宣说此般若总持,被称为「是大神咒(mahamantra)、是大明咒(mahavidyamantra)、是无上咒(anuttaramantra)、是无等等咒(asamasamamantra),能除一切苦,真实不虚」。
v: tasmaj jnatavyam — prajnaparamita mahamantro mahavidyamantro 'nuttaramantro 'samasamamantrah, sarvaduhkhaprasamanah, satyam amithyatvat | prajnaparamitayam ukto mantrah | 故知般若波罗蜜多,是大神咒,是大明咒,是无上咒,是无等等咒,能除一切苦,真实不虚。故说般若波罗蜜多咒, 达斯玛吉 吉尼亚达维央 | 普啦吉尼亚巴啦米达 玛哈曼特洛 玛哈-维地呀曼特洛 努达啦曼特洛 萨玛萨玛曼特啦赫 萨尔瓦-杜忽卡普啦沙玛拿赫 萨蒂央 阿米提呀特瓦特 | 普啦吉尼亚巴啦米达央 乌克多 曼特啦赫 是故应当了知:般若波罗蜜多是大神咒、是大明咒、是无上咒、是无等等咒,能平息一切苦厄,因不虚妄故真实不虚。于般若波罗蜜多中宣说真言:

entries.m: 秽迹金刚 / 乌枢沙摩明王 (ucchusma-krodharaja) (唐)北天竺三藏沙门阿质达霰 译 《秽迹金刚说神通大满陀罗尼法术灵要门》(t21n1228) / 《秽迹金刚禁百变法经》(t21n1229) 释迦牟尼佛临涅槃时,螺髻梵王以鄙秽不净物障难大众,佛自左心化出不坏金刚(秽迹金刚),立往梵天化诸不净为大宝地。此四十二字神咒能除一切瘟疫、鬼魅、蛊毒、邪法,不拣净秽,持诵圆满感得杵出光焰、水涌沸腾之验相。

entries.m: 北方多闻天王 · 黄财神瞻巴拉 · 摩诃迦罗大黑天 · 圣天欢喜天 · 坚牢地神 · 妙音辩才天女 (唐)不空三藏 / 义净 / 善无畏 译 · gretil 梵本对勘 《毗沙门天王经》(t21n1245) / 《大圣欢喜双身大自在天毗那夜迦王归依念诵供养法》(t21n1270) / 《大黑天神法》(t21n1287) / 《坚牢地天仪轨》(t21n1286) 完整收录佛教护世诸天与资粮护法本尊真言:一、北方多闻天王(毗沙门天 vaisravana)护国施财真言;二、黄财神(jambhala 瞻巴拉)水浴増益心咒;三、摩诃迦罗大黑天(mahakala)除贫护法咒;四、大圣欢喜天(ganapati)除障满愿咒;五、坚牢地神(prthivi)安宅丰饶咒;六、大辩才天女(sarasvati)无碍辩才智慧咒。

entries.m: 耆那五圣尊(阿罗汉·悉达·阿阇梨·亲教师·一切圣僧)· 瑜伽祖师帕坦伽利 (patanjali) 大雄尊者(mahavira)传承圣众 · 乌玛斯瓦蒂《谛义证得经》与帕坦伽利传统 耆那教《六分阿笈摩》开篇根本咒 ·《谛义证得经(tattvarthasutra)》·《上师歌(guru-gita)》 完整收录印度沙门传统另一瑰宝——耆那教(jainism)跨越两千五百年之最高根本圣咒《五敬礼真言(panca-namaskara / namokara mantra)》(梵文标准本与俗语古音本对勘,不求世间神祇恩宠而纯粹礼敬五阶解脱觉者之清净德行),并附印度全宗派共通之《上师礼赞咒(gurur brahma)》及全球瑜伽行者课前必诵之《帕坦伽利祈请颂》。 【常用检索别称:耆那教五敬礼咒,那摩卡拉真言,五尊礼赞咒,不害最高法印,上师三宝梵赞,帕坦伽利瑜伽经开篇祈请颂,namokar mantra,navkar mantra,panca namaskara,gurur brahma,yogena cittasya】

v: na vyuhamnama samadhim prati labhate   不、非、无,最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·因缘空寂大乐,三摩地、正定等持,对,获
yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva sadhaka iti   设使,妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·真如实际,彼·羯磨事业·那个·犹如,本性寂静止息·法界总持任持·造作离相,如是(结句印定)

idamavocad bhagavanattamana aryava lokitesvaro bodhisatvo mahasatvastaca bhiksavastaica bodhisatva satcasuddhava saka-ika devaputra   施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说,世尊愉悦,圣鸿毛,随一·趣往·自在,菩提·彼·长柄,大·勇猛大士·故乡·及破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净,菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·妙行迁变空,融通,造作离相,施度调伏·最上真言离言说·第一义谛
sadeva manusa saragaruda gandharvvasca lokobha gavatositamabhya nandanniti   彼天人,无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·六度满行清净,流注周遍迦楼罗,音乐及世间星宿,妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·真如实际,离名相假立·施度调伏·真如实际
iti arya smoghapasanama hrdayammahayana sutram namadharanam parisamaptah om namah srilokanathaya   如是(结句印定),圣、尊贵圣者,矣·想必·罥索·名为,心大乘,界线,名为持,用完、圆满,嗡!归命,向吉祥世所宗奉
om namah srikhasarpyanayai   嗡(三身总持圣音)!归命,吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息

trailokya darpyanatha ekagracitta cittaya sakala lokavinasana karaya sarvasatvanatrya santi kurupustim kururaksa   三界、三千世界,施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛,一境心,向心、菩提心、心识,全部、圆满一切,世间·远离·古老,向掌,一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说,息灾、寂静、安隐,成办作持·造作离相,祈请成办羯磨事业守护
kurusiddhim kuru-om ah hrm hu phat svaha   祈请成办羯磨事业悉地,祈请成办羯磨事业(俱噜),嗡!语金刚种子字(一切法本不生清净妙语),贺字门(因缘空寂大乐(hetu,贺字门(因缘空寂大乐(hetu,泮吒(摧破魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
arya khasarpyanamadharani samapta   圣、尊贵圣者,总持任持·等虚空无碍,三磨钵耽
om namah trailokanatha   嗡(三身总持圣音)!归命,真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相
om namo bhagavate aryava lokitesvaraya bodhisatvaya mahasatvaya mahakarunikaya   嗡!归命,向世尊(薄伽梵)致敬,圣鸿毛,向随一趣往自在主,向菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),向摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者

om hile hile kite kiteni cite citeni svaha   嗡!再三因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相,造作离相·真如实际,造作离相·真如实际·离名相假立,积累、浓厚尊,妙行迁变空·真如实际·离名相假立,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

v: om namo bhagavate aparimitayurjnana-suviniscita-tejorajaya tathagataya arhate samyaksambuddhaya | tadyatha | om punye punye mahapunye   嗡!归命,向世尊(薄伽梵)致敬,无量寿智决定王如来圣智,报刊往外决定,向威光王,向如来(乘如实道来成正觉),向应供(阿罗汉)致敬,向正等正觉、正遍知;即说咒曰:嗡(三身总持圣音)!再三福德、胜妙功德尊,大福尊
aparimitayurpunya-jnana   无量寿智决定王如来福德,圣智、无漏真智
aparimitapunye aparimitapunya-jnana   无限量福德,无限量福德,圣智、无漏真智

om sarva-tathagata-sabda-puja-megha-samudra-spharana-samaye hum   嗡!一切、普皆遍满,如来(乘如实道来成正觉),声,供,云,大海、生死海,遍,向平,吽(金刚心印)!

tadyatha   即说咒曰:

anaya dharanyodakasahitam bhaktam sapta varan parijapya vamahastenacchatatrayam dattva sarvapretebhyo vivikte pradese datavyam   此,放置·愉快·浮肿·一连,饼,七(七佛,人群、海众,般一样,左·手·勇健·弹指·三重,齿已,向诸湖剪切力此等诸尊,远离尊,所尊,施予
evam ca bhasitavyam   如是、如此以及宣说演畅·破有相福德光
apasarantv avatarapreksino dadamy aham sarvalokadhatuvasinam pretanam aharam iti   第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢,生事,施予饶益·施度调伏,我、真我自性,世界·界·天衣·勇健,诸饿鬼、薜荔多之,楼阁,如是(结句印定)
abhuktenaiva kartavyam   破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际,任务
evam sarvapretanam tanduladronabhaktam pratyekam dattam bhavati   如是、如此,一切诸饿鬼,水稻·斗斛·饼,别主,施度调伏·真如实际,成办、生起、安住
evam kurvan na durbalo bhavati na daridro bhavaty api tu jatau   如是、如此,成办作持·造作离相,不、非、无,弱,成办、生起、安住,不、非、无,流浪者、贫苦,破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际,亦、虽、乃至,然而、而、实则,生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际

tadyatha — om vajradharma-hrdaya-garbhe sarvapapa-avarana-visodhani sarvabuddha-adhisthana-adhisthite samanta-avabhasa-vijaye svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!金刚正法,心、心髓、根本心咒,藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊,一切罪业,障蔽、烦恼所知障,闢理由,一切佛陀,加持、神力摄持,所加持、安住摄持尊,普遍、周遍十方,普光明照、遍照瑞光,最胜尊胜、普胜一切!尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

om manidhari vajrini mahapratisare sarvavighna-vinayakan vidhvamsaya raksa raksa mam sarvasattvams ca hum hum phat phat svaha   嗡!持摩尼宝珠(如意离垢宝)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大随求佛母(随愿即得大明王母)尊,一切障碍,毗那夜迦(常随障难鬼王),请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余!祈请再三拥护、守护于我,诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!泮吒泮吒(顿断一切魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

om ahara ahara mama ayuh-samdharani sodhaya sodhaya visodhaya visodhaya gagana-svabhava-visuddhe   嗡!再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养!我之(行者所有),寿命、无量寿,擎尊,再三请净除、涤荡清净!再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障!虚空、清净苍穹,自性、本然体性,最极清净、究竟净除尊

usnisavijaya-parisuddhe sahasra-rasmi-samcodite sarvatathagata-avalokini sat-paramita-paripurani sarvatathagata-mate dasa-bhumi-pratisthite sarvatathagata-hrdaya-adhisthana-adhisthite   佛顶肉髻相最胜尊胜,圆满清净、周遍无垢尊,千、千手千眼,光芒、百千光明聚,一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空·施度调伏,一切如来,最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相,六(六度,波罗蜜多(度彼岸、究竟圆满),般遂尊,一切如来,母尊,十(十方,地、菩萨十地,踞尊,一切如来,心、心髓、根本心咒,加持、神力摄持,所加持、安住摄持尊

om mudre mudre mahamudre vajra-kaya-samhatana-parisuddhe sarvakarmavarana-visuddhe pratinivartaya mama ayur-visuddhe sarvatathagata-samaya-adhisthana-adhisthite om muni   嗡!再三阶位双手尊,大手印、大法契印尊,金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障),身、佛身法身,好好儿编织不,圆满清净、周遍无垢尊,一切业障,最极清净、究竟净除尊,请回遮逆转(灾厄)、令寿复延!我之(行者所有),寿命(连音式),最极清净、究竟净除尊,一切如来,三昧耶(本誓、平等契合、时际),加持、神力摄持,所加持、安住摄持尊,嗡!牟尼、寂默圣者

muni mahamuni vimuni mahavimuni mati mati mahamati mamati sumati tathata-bhutakoti-parisuddhe visphuta-buddhi-suddhe he   牟尼、寂默圣者,大牟尼尊(释迦世尊),闢牟尼,大·闢·牟尼,再三慧、正念妙慧,大慧,我之(行者所有),善心、人情,真如、如实法性,实际、真如本际,圆满清净、周遍无垢尊,闢开,觉慧、明觉,清净、纯洁无染尊,呼唤圣尊叹词(咄!圣者!)
he jaya jaya vijaya vijaya smara smara sphara sphara spharaya spharaya sarvabuddha-adhisthana-adhisthite   呼唤圣尊叹词(咄!圣者!),再三胜伏、最胜吉祥!再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切!再三忆念本誓,再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界!再三请大放光明遍照十方!一切佛陀,加持、神力摄持,所加持、安住摄持尊

suddhe suddhe buddhe buddhe vajre vajre mahavajre suvajre vajragarbhe jaya-garbhe vijaya-garbhe vajra-jvala-garbhe   再三清净、纯洁无染尊,再三佛陀、觉者尊,再三金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大金刚尊,勇健金刚杵尊,金刚藏尊,胜伏、最胜吉祥!藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊,最胜尊胜、普胜一切!藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊,金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障),光焰、智慧炽盛火焰,藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊

vajrodbhave vajrasambhave vajre vajrini vajram bhavatu mama sariram sarvasattvanam ca kaya-parisuddhis ca   金刚氏族,金刚三婆婆尊,金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,金刚,愿成就、愿悉吉祥,我之(行者所有),躯,诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及身、佛身法身,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息以及
bhavatu me sada sarvagati-parisuddhis ca sarvatathagatas ca mam samasvasayantu   愿成就、愿悉吉祥,于我、为我,恒常、一切时,趣往一切处、圆通,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息以及一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及我,愿诸如来慈悲安慰授记!
om siddhya siddhya buddhya buddhya bodhaya bodhaya vibodhaya vibodhaya mocaya mocaya vimocaya   嗡!再三请成就妙悉地!再三请觉察、慈悲垂念!再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智!再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉!再三请解脱、令离系缚!请究竟解脱、度脱苦厄!

vimocaya sodhaya sodhaya visodhaya visodhaya samantan mocaya samanta-rasmi-parisuddhe sarvatathagata-hrdaya-adhisthana-adhisthite mudre mudre mahamudre   请究竟解脱、度脱苦厄!再三请净除、涤荡清净!再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障!普遍、周遍十方,请解脱、令离系缚!普遍、周遍十方,光芒、百千光明聚,圆满清净、周遍无垢尊,一切如来,心、心髓、根本心咒,加持、神力摄持,所加持、安住摄持尊,再三阶位双手尊,大手印、大法契印尊
mahamudra-mantra-padaih svaha   大手印、大法契印,真言、密咒(护心密语),以诸句、足迹、法位,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
iti srimad-aryosnisavijaya-dharani samapta   如是(结句印定),吉祥泡沫,圣佛顶尊胜佛母,陀罗尼、总持(总一切法、持无量义),三磨钵耽

v: om namo bhagavatyai aryasrivasudharayai   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,吉祥庄严·总持任持·清净离诸尘垢
kalpoditena vidhina paripasyamana, ya dharaya vividhi (!) ratnasuvarnnamayya   以细轨演,以法事,般·了知·慢,凡彼(阴性关系代词),以边缘、方圆,各个、种种尊,以珍宝真金于我身中

purnnam karoti bhavana (!) sahasava (!) sarvvam tan sarvval o ka jan ani (!) pranamami bhaktya   圆满无缺法界体,掌正勤,住埸,威势鸿毛,一切、普皆遍满,仰字门(支分寂静(anga)·远离寂静周遍),湖转动,悉昙「o」韵字门:摄受法流灌顶,迦字门(造作离相(karya)·本不生体性),曩字门(离名相假立(nama)·本不生体性),离名相假立,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤,以物流、瓜分
evam maya srutam ekasmin samaye bhagavan kosambyam mahanagaryam viharati sma kantakasa [   如是、如此,由我(具格:如是我闻),闻,一时,向平,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,造作离相·本性寂静止息·无我大慈三昧,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,一切,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),刺彼

mjn ] ke mahavanavare ghosiralame mahata mahabhiksusaghena sardham pa ncamatrair bhiksusataih sabahu   若字门(般若无分别圣智(jnana)·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持),迦字门(造作离相(karya)·钩召发起三昧),酒席·鸿毛·那婆罗尊,吞食·众多·是的尊,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,以大比丘平等,俱,跛字门(第一义谛(paramartha)·本不生体性),圣智通达·妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧,以诸比丘百,彼多
lais ca mahasra vakair asamkhyayas (!) ca bodhisatvair mmahasatvaih sarvabuddhasamanvagataih   奢字门(本性寂静止息(santi)·大自在威德统摄)以及大沸腾,最上真言离言说·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢,一切诸谛圆满·等虚空无碍·一乘如实之道以及菩提·参半·极微,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,以诸一切佛陀成就

incipit, section: tena khalu punah samayena kosambya (!) mahanagaryam sucandro nama grhapatih prativasati sma   离名相假立·妙行迁变空·第一义谛,一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空·真如实际,借由彼力、以是因缘,诚然、确实,复次、再三,以三昧耶(本誓、平等契合、时际),造作离相·本性寂静止息·解脱系缚大力,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,妙月,名为、号曰,理家,对髁骨,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性)
idam avocad bhagavan attamana ayusman anandas te ca bhiksavas te ca bodhisatva   此、此妙法,最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·施度调伏,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,愉悦、伊人,具寿,离名相假立·施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满,向汝、彼等以及希望人情,向汝、彼等以及菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情)

mahasattva sa ca sarvavati parsat sadevamanusasuraga ndharvaloko bhagavato bhasitam abhyanandann iti   摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),彼、彼圣母(阴性主格)以及具足湖或,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净,彼·天人·人道·气息·宝树宝山,持守摄受·离名相假立,以世尊此,妙语、语言,破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立,如是(结句印定)
aryasrivasudhara nama dharani samapta h   圣·吉祥·财源佛母,名为、号曰,陀罗尼、总持(总一切法、持无量义),三磨钵耽,悉昙「h」韵字门:本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入

ye dharmma hetuprabhava hetu tesan tathagato hy avadat tesan ca yo nirodha evamva di mahasramanah   凡彼等诸有情,正法、诸法实相,因威,因,真如实际·六度满行清净·离名相假立,如来,耶字门(一乘如实之道(yana)·本不生体性),最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际,真如实际·六度满行清净·圣智通达以及凡彼圣尊、能...者,灭谛,如是或,陀字门(施度调伏(dana,乐趣·精庐·我等
dheyadharmo   驮都正法

yam 'pravaramahayanayayinah paramopasaka (!) sriphatasalagrhadhivasinajaka najabharobharyaputrapautradi [ h ] sagaraparivarasya yad atra   风大自在除障种子,广大殊胜·第一义谛,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧,吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息,离名相假立·生起不可得·尊胜·破有相福德光,悉昙「h」韵字门:本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入,气象眷属之,凡所...者,于此处、今此

punyam tad bhavatv acaryopadhya yamatapitrpurvangaman krtva sakalasatvarase r anuttarajnanaphalam avapnuyad iti   福德、胜妙功德,彼、如是真实,破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际,以阿遮利耶更代,趣入通行·一乘如实之道,既作已、行持已,全部·迅疾·望尊,啰字门(清净离诸尘垢(rajas)·本不生体性),无上·圣智·果,最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离名相假立,如是(结句印定)
samvat 676 jestamase krsnapakse caturthyayam tithau brhaspativarasare   随着不过逮捕,生起不可得·尊胜·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障,下半月尊,妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢,真如实际·无住安立,木星·人群·流注周遍
maharajadhirajaparamesvaraparamabhattaraka-srisrijayasadasivamalladevasya vijayarajye   大王·大自在·童子大王·最胜·尊神,吉祥·吉祥·胜伏·恒常·寂静·大勇力士·天人,最胜尊胜油脂乳糜尊
subham astu   清净吉祥、善妙庄严,愿得成就、当如是

tadyatha — om gate gate paragate parasamgate bodhi svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊!度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸!普同度至彼岸吧(圆证菩提)!菩提、无上正觉,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om dhih sruti-smrti-vijaye svaha   嗡!文殊般若心印(甚深智慧总持),闻,正念、忆持不忘,最胜尊胜、普胜一切!尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

v: om namo bhagavatyai arya-pancaraksa-devatabhyah   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,圣、尊贵圣者,五眼目,向诸天神
namah sarvatathagatanam sarvabhayavigatanam   归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离!
tadyatha — om manidhari vajrini mahapratisare raksa raksa mam sarvasattvams ca svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!持摩尼宝珠(如意离垢宝)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大随求佛母(随愿即得大明王母)尊,祈请再三拥护、守护于我,诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mayurakrante svaha   嗡(三身总持圣音)!孔雀措施尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahasahasrapramardani sarvagraha-naksatra-vidhvamsani hum phat svaha   嗡!大·因达罗·摧碎,一切曜执,星宿(二十八宿),摧灭尊,吽(金刚心印)!泮吒(摧破魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahasitavati sarva-upadrava-prasamani svaha   嗡!具足大冷尊,一切、普皆遍满,灾横、恼害横祸,疗尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahamantranusarini sarvapapa-visodhani svaha   嗡!贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样,一切罪业,闢理由,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
iti sri-pancaraksa-mahavidyarajni-dharani samapta   如是(结句印定),吉祥、圣德威光,五眼目,大明妃,陀罗尼、总持(总一切法、持无量义),三磨钵耽

v: om namah sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyah   嗡(三身总持圣音)!归命,向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
namo ratnatrayaya   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝!

tadyatha — om vajradharma-hrdaya-garbhe sarvapapa-avarana-visodhani sarvabuddha-adhisthana-adhisthite samanta-avabhasa-vijaye svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!金刚正法,心、心髓、根本心咒,藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊,一切罪业,障蔽、烦恼所知障,闢理由,一切佛陀,加持、神力摄持,所加持、安住摄持尊,普遍、周遍十方,普光明照、遍照瑞光,最胜尊胜、普胜一切!尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

om manidhari vajrini mahapratisare sarvavighna-vinayakan vidhvamsaya raksa raksa mam sarvasattvams ca hum hum phat phat svaha   嗡!持摩尼宝珠(如意离垢宝)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大随求佛母(随愿即得大明王母)尊,一切障碍,毗那夜迦(常随障难鬼王),请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余!祈请再三拥护、守护于我,诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!泮吒泮吒(顿断一切魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

v: om namo bhagavate aparimitayurjnanasuviniscitatejorajaya tathagatayarhate samyaksambuddhaya   嗡!归命,向世尊(薄伽梵)致敬,向无量寿智决定王如来·圣智·报刊往外·决定·威光·王,如来·出·堪敬尊,向正等正觉、正遍知
tadyatha — om punya punya mahapunya aparimitapunya aparimitapunyajnanasambharopacite   即说咒曰:嗡!再三福德、胜妙功德,大福,无限量福德,无限量·福德·圣智·资粮·积累尊
om sarvasamskaraparisuddhadharmate gaganasamudgate svabhavavisuddhe mahanayaparivare svaha   嗡!一切·行·圆满清净·正法,虚空器箧,自性最极清净,大·此处·眷属尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

v: om namo bhagavatyai arya-suvarnaprabhasottamayai sutrendrarajayai   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,圣、尊贵圣者,一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢,一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
tadyatha — om sri-mahadeviye laksmi-samvardhani svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!吉祥、圣德威光,摩诃室利此处尊,吉祥相,孵化尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

tadyatha — siddhe susiddhe mocani moksani mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale mangalye hiranyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvarthasadhani svaha   即说咒曰:成就者、已成就尊,善妙成就、最胜悉地尊,解放尊,自由化尊,除此之外,究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊,无垢、离染清净尊,毗磨利,净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊,最极吉祥、致福清净尊,金胎神尊,宝藏尊,一切义利成就法,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

namo ratnatrayaya   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝!

om sri-vasumukhi svaha   嗡!吉祥、圣德威光,财物面门,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om vasudhe svaha   嗡(三身总持圣音)!柔顺良好、优渥尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

v: om namo bhagavatyai arya-sri-vasudharayai   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,圣、尊贵圣者,吉祥、圣德威光,总持任持·最上真言离言说
namo ratnatrayaya   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝!
namo bhagavate vajradhara-sagara-nirghosaya tathagatayarhate samyaksambuddhaya   归命顶礼世尊(薄伽梵)致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知!
tadyatha — om surupe bhadravati mangale acale acapale ughatini ubhedini sasyavati dhanyavati   即说咒曰:嗡!善见尊,具足贤尊,吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊,不动明王、不动摇尊,无动摇尊,破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立,破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立,具足稼尊,具足驮他尊
dhanavati srimati prabhavati amale vimale nirmale ruru surupe vimale   具足财尊,吉祥宝部心印(福德庄严总持),威,无垢、离染清净尊,毗磨利,净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊,大悲流注、光明赫奕!善见尊,毗磨利
om sri-vasudhara-ratna-nidhana-ksetre svaha   嗡!吉祥、圣德威光,财源佛母(持世丰饶母),珍宝、摩尼宝,藏,田尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om vasudharini maha-vasu-vrsti-nipatini sarvasattvanam daridrya-duhkha-prasamani svaha   嗡!财物具请执持,大、摩诃(广大无边),财物,一雨,上首·太·在于,诸一切众生、普皆有情之,乏,苦、一切逼恼苦厄,疗尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om sri-vasumukhi svaha   嗡!吉祥、圣德威光,财物面门,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om vasudhe svaha   嗡(三身总持圣音)!柔顺良好、优渥尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

v: om namo bhagavatyai arya-pancaraksa-devatabhyah   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,圣、尊贵圣者,五眼目,向诸天神
namah sarvatathagatanam sarvabhayavigatanam   归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离!
tadyatha — om manidhari vajrini mahapratisare raksa raksa mam sarvasattvams ca svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!持摩尼宝珠(如意离垢宝)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大随求佛母(随愿即得大明王母)尊,祈请再三拥护、守护于我,诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mayurakrante svaha   嗡(三身总持圣音)!孔雀措施尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahasahasrapramardani sarvagraha-naksatra-vidhvamsani hum phat svaha   嗡!大·因达罗·摧碎,一切曜执,星宿(二十八宿),摧灭尊,吽(金刚心印)!泮吒(摧破魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahasitavati sarva-upadrava-prasamani svaha   嗡!具足大冷尊,一切、普皆遍满,灾横、恼害横祸,疗尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahamantranusarini sarvapapa-visodhani svaha   嗡!贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样,一切罪业,闢理由,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
iti sri-pancaraksa-mahavidyarajni-dharani samapta   如是(结句印定),吉祥、圣德威光,五眼目,大明妃,陀罗尼、总持(总一切法、持无量义),三磨钵耽

v: om namo bhagavatyai arya-sri-vasudharayai   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,圣、尊贵圣者,吉祥、圣德威光,总持任持·最上真言离言说
namo ratnatrayaya   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝!
namo bhagavate vajradhara-sagara-nirghosaya tathagatayarhate samyaksambuddhaya   归命顶礼世尊(薄伽梵)致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知!
tadyatha — om surupe bhadravati mangale acale acapale ughatini ubhedini sasyavati dhanyavati   即说咒曰:嗡!善见尊,具足贤尊,吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊,不动明王、不动摇尊,无动摇尊,破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立,破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立,具足稼尊,具足驮他尊
dhanavati srimati prabhavati amale vimale nirmale ruru surupe vimale   具足财尊,吉祥宝部心印(福德庄严总持),威,无垢、离染清净尊,毗磨利,净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊,大悲流注、光明赫奕!善见尊,毗磨利
om sri-vasudhara-ratna-nidhana-ksetre svaha   嗡!吉祥、圣德威光,财源佛母(持世丰饶母),珍宝、摩尼宝,藏,田尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om vasudharini maha-vasu-vrsti-nipatini sarvasattvanam daridrya-duhkha-prasamani svaha   嗡!财物具请执持,大、摩诃(广大无边),财物,一雨,上首·太·在于,诸一切众生、普皆有情之,乏,苦、一切逼恼苦厄,疗尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om sri-vasumukhi svaha   嗡!吉祥、圣德威光,财物面门,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om vasudhe svaha   嗡(三身总持圣音)!柔顺良好、优渥尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

namo ratnatrayaya   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝!

tadyatha — om vajradharma-hrdaya-garbhe sarvapapa-avarana-visodhani sarvabuddha-adhisthana-adhisthite samanta-avabhasa-vijaye svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!金刚正法,心、心髓、根本心咒,藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊,一切罪业,障蔽、烦恼所知障,闢理由,一切佛陀,加持、神力摄持,所加持、安住摄持尊,普遍、周遍十方,普光明照、遍照瑞光,最胜尊胜、普胜一切!尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

om manidhari vajrini mahapratisare sarvavighna-vinayakan vidhvamsaya raksa raksa mam sarvasattvams ca hum hum phat phat svaha   嗡!持摩尼宝珠(如意离垢宝)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大随求佛母(随愿即得大明王母)尊,一切障碍,毗那夜迦(常随障难鬼王),请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余!祈请再三拥护、守护于我,诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!泮吒泮吒(顿断一切魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

svaha   圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

v: om namo bhagavatyai arya-pancaraksa-devatabhyah   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,圣、尊贵圣者,五眼目,向诸天神
namah sarvatathagatanam sarvabhayavigatanam   归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离!
tadyatha — om manidhari vajrini mahapratisare raksa raksa mam sarvasattvams ca svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!持摩尼宝珠(如意离垢宝)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大随求佛母(随愿即得大明王母)尊,祈请再三拥护、守护于我,诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mayurakrante svaha   嗡(三身总持圣音)!孔雀措施尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahasahasrapramardani sarvagraha-naksatra-vidhvamsani hum phat svaha   嗡!大·因达罗·摧碎,一切曜执,星宿(二十八宿),摧灭尊,吽(金刚心印)!泮吒(摧破魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahasitavati sarva-upadrava-prasamani svaha   嗡!具足大冷尊,一切、普皆遍满,灾横、恼害横祸,疗尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahamantranusarini sarvapapa-visodhani svaha   嗡!贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样,一切罪业,闢理由,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
iti sri-pancaraksa-mahavidyarajni-dharani samapta   如是(结句印定),吉祥、圣德威光,五眼目,大明妃,陀罗尼、总持(总一切法、持无量义),三磨钵耽

namah kanakanilabja- panipadmavibhusite | danaviryatapahsanti- titiksadhyanagocare 敬礼紫磨金色母 妙莲华手胜庄严 施精勤行柔善靜 忍辱禪定性无境  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §5】chi: t.1108a:敬礼紫磨金色母 妙莲华手胜庄严 施精勤行柔善靜 忍辱禪定性无境 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal gser sno chu nas skyes kyi | | pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma | | sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zi ba | | bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nid ma | |(3)

namas tathagatosnisa- vijayanantacarini | 'sesaparamitaprapta- jinaputranisevite 敬礼如來顶髻母 最胜能满无邊行 得到彼岸盡无餘 胜勢佛子極所爱  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §6】chi: t.1108a:敬礼如來顶髻母 最胜能满无邊行 得到彼岸盡无餘 胜勢佛子極所爱 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal de bzin gsegs pa'i gtsug tor | | mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma | | ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i | | rgyal ba'i sras kyis sin tu bsten ma | |(4)

namas tutrarehumkara- puritasadigantare | saptalokakramakranti nisesakarsanaksame 敬礼怛啰吽字母 聲爱方所满虚空 運足遍履七世界 悉能鉤召摄无餘  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §7】chi: t.1108a:敬礼怛啰吽字母 聲爱方所满虚空 運足遍履七世界 悉能鉤召摄无餘 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal tutta ra hum yi ge | | 'dod dan phyogs dan nam mkha' gan ma | | 'jig rten bdun po zabs kyis mnan te | | lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma | |(5)

namah sakranalabrahma- marudvisvesvararcite | bhutavetalagandharva- ganayaksapuraskrte 敬礼释梵火天母 風神自在众俱集 部多起屍尋香等 诸药叉众作稱歎  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §8】chi: t.1108a:敬礼释梵火天母 風神自在众俱集 部多起屍尋香等 诸药叉众作稱歎 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshans pa | | rlun lha sna tshogs dban phyug mchod ma | | 'byun po ro lans dri za rnams dan | | gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma | |(6)

namas trad iti phatkara- parayantrapramardini | pratyalidhapadanyase sikhijvalakulojjvale 敬礼特啰胝发母 於他加行極摧坏 展左踡右作足踏 顶髻炽盛極明耀  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §9】chi: t.1108a:敬礼特啰胝发母 於他加行極摧坏 展左踡右作足踏 顶髻炽盛極明耀 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal trat ces bya dan phat kyis | | pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma | | g.yas bskum g.yon brkyan zabs kyis mnan te | | me 'bar 'khrugs pa sin tu 'bar ma | |(7)

namas ture mahaghore malaviravinasini | bhrkutikrtavaktrabja- sarvasatrunisudini 敬礼都哩大緊母 勇猛能摧怨魔類 於莲华面作顰眉 摧坏一切冤家众  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §10】chi: t.1108a:敬礼都哩大緊母 勇猛能摧怨魔類 於莲华面作顰眉 摧坏一切冤家众 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo | | bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma | | chu skyes zal ni khro gner ldan mdzad | | dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma | |(8)

namas triratnamudranka- hrdyangulivibhusite | bhusitasesadikcakra- nikarasvakarakule 敬礼三宝严印母 手指當心威严相 严飾方轮盡无餘 自身炽盛光聚種  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §11】chi: t.1108a:敬礼三宝严印母 手指當心威严相 严飾方轮盡无餘 自身炽盛光聚種 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i | | sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma | | ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i | | ran gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrug ma | |(9)

namah pramuditasesa- muktaksiraprasarini | hasatprahasattutare maralokavasamkari 敬礼威德欢悅母 宝冠珠鬘众光飾 最極喜笑覩怛哩 鎮世間魔作摄伏  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】chi: t.1108a:敬礼威德欢悅母 宝冠珠鬘众光飾 最極喜笑覩怛哩 鎮世間魔作摄伏 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i | | dbu rgyan 'od kyi phren ba spel ma | | bzad pa rab bzad tu tta ra yis | | bdud dan 'jig rten dban du mdzad ma | |(10)

namah samantabhupala- patalakarsanaksame | caladbhrkutihumkara- sarvapadavimocini 敬礼守护众地母 亦能鉤召诸神众 搖顰眉面吽聲字 一切衰敗令度脫  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §13】chi: t.1108a:敬礼守护众地母 亦能鉤召诸神众 搖顰眉面吽聲字 一切衰敗令度脫 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal sa gzi skyon ba'i tshogs rnams | | thams cad 'gugs par nus ma nid ma | | khro gner g.yo ba'i yi ge hum gis | | phons pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma | |(11)

namah sikhandakhandendu- mukutabharanojjvale | amitabhajatabhara- bhasvarakiranadhruve 敬礼顶冠月相母 冠中現胜妙严光 阿弥陀佛髻中現 常放众妙宝光明  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §14】chi: t.1108a:敬礼顶冠月相母 冠中現胜妙严光 阿弥陀佛髻中現 常放众妙宝光明 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtse mos dbu brgyan | | brgyan pa thams cad sin tu 'bar ma | | ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las | | rtag par sin tu 'od ni mdzad ma | |(12)

namah kalpantahutabhug- jvalamalantarasthite | alidhamuditabaddha- ripucakravinasini 敬礼如盡劫火母 安住炽盛顶髻中 普遍喜悅半趺坐 能摧灭坏恶冤轮  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §15】chi: t.1108a:敬礼如盡劫火母 安住炽盛顶髻中 普遍喜悅半趺坐 能摧灭坏恶冤轮 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar | | 'bar ba'i phren ba'i dbus na gnas ma | | g.yas brkyan g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dgas | | dgra yi dpun ni rnam par 'joms ma | |(13)

namah karatalaghata- caranahatabhutale | bhrkutikrtahumkara- saptapatalabhedini 敬礼手按大地母 以足踐蹋作鎮壓 現顰眉面作吽聲 能破七險鎮降伏  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §16】chi: t.1108a:敬礼手按大地母 以足踐蹋作鎮壓 現顰眉面作吽聲 能破七險鎮降伏 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal sa gzi'i nos la phyag gi | | mthil gyis bsnun cin zabs kyis brdun ma | | khro gner can mdzad yi ge hum gis | | rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma | |(14)

namah sive subhe sante santanirvanagocare | svahapranavasamyukte mahapatakanasini 敬礼安隱柔善母 涅槃寂灭最樂境 莎訶命種以相應 善能消灭大灾禍  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §17】chi: t.1108a:敬礼安隱柔善母 涅槃寂灭最樂境 莎訶命種以相應 善能消灭大灾禍 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zi ma | | mya nan 'das zi spyod yul nid ma | | sva ha om dan yan dag ldan pas | | sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nid ma | |(15)

namah pramuditabaddha- ripugatraprabhedini | dasaksarapadanyasa- vidyahumkaradipite 敬礼普遍極喜母 诸怨支體令脫离 十字咒句妙严布 明咒吽聲常朗耀  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §18】chi: t.1108a:敬礼普遍極喜母 诸怨支體令脫离 十字咒句妙严布 明咒吽聲常朗耀 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i | | dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma | | yi ge bcu pa'i nag ni bkod pa'i | | rig pa hum las sgron ma nid ma | |(16)

namas ture padaghate humkarabijite | merumandarakailasa- bhuvanatrayacalini 敬礼都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 弥嚕曼陀結辣萨 於此三處能搖动  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §19】chi: t.1108a:敬礼都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 弥嚕曼陀結辣萨 於此三處能搖动 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal tu re'i zabs ni brdabs pas | | hum gi rnam pa'i sa bon nid ma | | ri rab man da ra dan 'bigs byed | | 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nid ma | |(17)

namah surasarakara- harinankakarasthite | taradviruktaphatkara asesavisanasini 敬礼萨啰天海母 手中執住神獸像 诵二怛啰作发聲 能灭诸毒盡无餘  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §20】chi: t.1108a:敬礼萨啰天海母 手中執住神獸像 诵二怛啰作发聲 能灭诸毒盡无餘 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i | | ri dags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma | | ta ra gnis brjod phat kyi yi ges | | dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma | |(18)

namah suraganayaksa- kimnarasevite | abaddhamuditabhoga- kaliduhsvapnanasini 敬礼诸天集会母 天緊那罗所依爱 威德欢悅若坚鎧 灭除鬪諍及恶夢  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §21】chi: t.1108a:敬礼诸天集会母 天緊那罗所依爱 威德欢悅若坚鎧 灭除鬪諍及恶夢 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po | | lha dan mi'am ci yis bsten ma | | kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis | | rtsod dan rmi lam nan pa sel ma | |(19)

namas candrarkasampurna- nayanadyutibhasvare | haradviruktatuttare- visamajvaranasini 敬礼日月广圆母 目覩猶胜普光照 诵二喝啰咄怛哩 善除恶毒瘟熱病  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §22】chi: t.1108a:敬礼日月广圆母 目覩猶胜普光照 诵二喝啰咄怛哩 善除恶毒瘟熱病 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal ni ma zla ba rgyas pa'i | | spyan gnis po la 'od rab gsal ma | | ha ra gnis brjod tu tta ra yis | | sin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma | |(20)

namah tritatavinyasa- sivasaktisamanvite | grahavetalayaksosma- nasini pravare ture 敬礼具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 药叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除灾禍  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §23】chi: t.1108a:敬礼具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 药叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除灾禍 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):phyag 'tshal de nid gsum rnams bkod pa'i | | zi ba'i mthu dan yan dag ldan ma | | gdon dan ro lans gnod sbyin tshogs rnams | | 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nid ma | |(21)

mantramulam idam stotram namaskaraikavimsakam | yah pathet prasannadhiman devyam bhaktisamanvitah 若有智者勤精進 至心诵此二十一 救度尊處誠信礼 是故赞嘆根本咒  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §24】chi: t.1108a:若有智者勤精進 至心诵此二十一 救度尊處誠信礼 是故赞嘆根本咒 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):rtsa ba'i snags kyis bstod pa 'di dan | | phyag 'tshal ba ni ni su rtsa gcig | | lha mo la gus yan dag ldan pa'i | | blo ldan gan gis rab tu brjod pas | |(22)

sayam va pratarutthaya smaret sarvabhayapradam | sarvapapaprasamanam sarvadurgatinasanam 每晨旦起夕時礼 憶念施诸胜无畏 一切罪业盡消除 悉能超越诸恶趣  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §25】chi: t.1108a:每晨旦起夕時礼 憶念施诸胜无畏 一切罪业盡消除 悉能超越诸恶趣 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):srod dan tho rans lans par byas nas | | dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster | | sdig pa thams cad rab tu zi ba | | nan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa nid do | (23)

abhisikto bhavet turnam saptabhir jinakotibhih | asmin mahattvam apadya so 'nte bauddhapadam vrajet 此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌顶 現世富貴寿延安 當來趣向诸佛位  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §26】chi: t.1108a:此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌顶 現世富貴寿延安 當來趣向诸佛位 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis | | myur du dban ni bskur bar 'gyur la | | 'di las che ba nid ni 'thob cin | | sans rgyas go 'phan mthar thug der 'gro | |(24)

visam tasya mahaghoram sthavaram vatha jangamam | smaranat pralayam yati khaditam pitam eva va 有時誤服诸毒物 或自然生或合成 憶念圣尊真實力 诸恶毒药盡消灭  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §27】chi: t.1108a:有時誤服诸毒物 或自然生或合成 憶念圣尊真實力 诸恶毒药盡消灭 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):de yi dug ni drag po chen po | | brtan gnas pa'am gzan yan 'gro ba | | zos pa dan ni 'thuns pa nid kyan | | dran pas rab tu sel ba nid thob | |(25)

grahajvaravisartinam paramativisanasanam | anyesam caiva sattvanam dvitrisaptabhivarttinam 或見他人遭鬼魅 或发熱病受诸苦 若轉此赞二三七 彼诸苦惱悉蠲除  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §28】chi: t.1108a:或見他人遭鬼魅 或发熱病受诸苦 若轉此赞二三七 彼诸苦惱悉蠲除 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):gdon dan rims dan dug gis gzir ba'i | | sdug bsnal tshogs ni rnam par spon ste | | sems can gzan pa rnams la yan no | | gnis gsum bdun du mnon par brjod na | |(26)

putrakamo labhet putram ghanakamo labhed dhanam | sarvakamanavapnoti na vighnaih pratihanyate 欲乞男女得男女 求財宝位獲富饒 善能圆满随意愿 一切障碍不能侵  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §29】chi: t.1108a:欲乞男女得男女 求財宝位獲富饒 善能圆满随意愿 一切障碍不能侵 | 藏本 (tib: kg, rgyud, ca):bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zin | | nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams nid thob | | 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te | | bgegs rnams med cin so sor 'joms 'gyur | |

v: nirvikalpapravesadharani (敦煌本入无分別总持经)  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:(敦煌本入无分別总持经) | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):(1a1) ’phags pa rnam par mi rtog par ’jug pa zes bya ba’i gzuns | (1b1) || rgya gar skad du | arya a bi kalpa pra be sa na ma dha ra ni | bod skad du | ’phags pa rnam par mi rtog par ’jug pa zes bya ba’i gzuns | sans rgyas dan byan chub (2) sems dpa’ thams cad la phyag ’tshal lo ||

1v1)(... evam maya srutam ekasmin sa)maye bhagavan rajagrhe virahati sma   【奥斯陆多本对勘 §2】梵本义译:嚩字门(最上真言离言说(vak,如是、如此,由我(具格:如是我闻),闻,一时,彼、此尊(阳性主格),过去、阿修罗尊,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,王舍城尊,分立从中、需要,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性) | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na |

tatra khalu bhagava(3)(n anekasatasahasraya parsada parivrtah puraskrto) dharmam desayati sma | yad uta dharmanam nirvikalpatam arabhya (1r1)(...)上首(...)世尊,百千众会前後圍繞,猶依诸法无分別而顯於法。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §3】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:(1r1)(...)上首(...)世尊,百千众会前後圍繞,猶依诸法无分別而顯於法。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya ston du mas yons su bskor te mdun (2) gyis bltas nas | 'di lta ste | theg pa chen po la chos rnams kyi rnam par mi rtog pa nyid las brtsams te chos ston to ||

tasya tani pari(2)(varjayatah tadanyani tattvanirupanavikalpani)mittani samudacaranty amukhibhavanty abhasagamanayogena 彼能遍遣彼想之時,有餘真實之想,現前而行。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §7】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:彼能遍遣彼想之時,有餘真實之想,現前而行。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):des de dag yons su spon ba na gzan de kho na la dpyod pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma rnams snan bar 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis kun tu 'byun zin (3a1) mnon du 'gyur te |

tasya tany api parivarjayato ’parani praptinirupanavikalpanimittani samudacaranty amukhibhavanty abhasagamanayogena 彼若遣除如是诸想之時,有餘證得分別之想,分明顯現、現前(35)而行。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §8】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:彼若遣除如是诸想之時,有餘證得分別之想,分明顯現、現前(35)而行。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):(3) des de dag yons su spon ba na gzan thob pa la dpyod pa rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma rnams snan bar 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis kun tu 'byun zin mnon du 'gyur te |

evam sa bodhisattvo mahasattva etani sarvakaravikalpanimittany amanasikaratah parivarjayan suprayukto bhavaty avikalpena 菩萨摩訶萨於如是等诸分別想,由不作意而能捨之,是名於无分別而勤學也。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §9】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:菩萨摩訶萨於如是等诸分別想,由不作意而能捨之,是名於无分別而勤學也。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):de ltar byan chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma'i rnam pa thams (7) cad yid la mi byed pas yons su spon ba na | de rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyins la sin tu brtson pa yin te |

tad yatha kulaputra ekaghanasaramayasya pasanaparvatasyadhastan mahananaratnaparipurnanidhih syad ( | ) bhasuranam vicitranam mahacintamaniratnanam | yad uta rupyaratnasya va | suvarnaratnasya va | (3)(asmagarbhananaratnasya va 善男子!譬如有一胜妙石藏之下,而有種種雜宝光色燦爛異常。所謂金、銀、琉璃、赤珠等(60)诸雜宝藏。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:善男子!譬如有一胜妙石藏之下,而有種種雜宝光色燦爛異常。所謂金、銀、琉璃、赤珠等(60)诸雜宝藏。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste | dper na brag gcig tu mkhregs sin sra ba'i 'og na yid bzin gyi nor bu rin po che chen po sna tshogs 'od gsal ba 'di lta ste | dnul rin po che dan | gser rin po che dan | rdo'i snyin po rin po che sna tshogs kyi rin po che tha dad pas yons su gan ba'i (2) gter chen po zig yod la |

tatha hi kulaputra iyam upama kr)ta yavad evasyarthasya vijnaptaye 作是語已,善男子,為了彼义而作此喻。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §13】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:作是語已,善男子,為了彼义而作此喻。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):rigs kyi bu dag ji tsam du don 'di ses par bya ba'i phyir 'di dper byas pa ste |

katham punah kulaputra bodhisattvo mahasattva etani yathanirdistani vikalpanimittani vyupapari(3r1)(ksamano ’vikalpadhatum pravisati 復次,善男子!如何菩萨摩訶萨以賴观察分別相故而能趣入无分別界耶?  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §14】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:復次,善男子!如何菩萨摩訶萨以賴观察分別相故而能趣入无分別界耶? | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):rigs kyi bu dag 'di ji ltar na yan byan chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rtog (5) pa'i mtshan ma ji skad bstan pa de dag la nye bar rtog cin rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyins su 'jug ce na |

iha kulaputrah bodhisattvo mahasattvah sarvakarajnatanirupanavikalpanimitta amukhibhuta evam vyupapariksate 善男子!此中菩萨摩​​訶萨,於一切種智上,起於如是分別。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §15】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:善男子!此中菩萨摩​​訶萨,於一切種智上,起於如是分別。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):rigs kyi bu dag 'di la byan chub sems dpa' (5b1) sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la spyod pa'i rnam par rtog pa mnon du gyur na | 'di ltar nye bar rtog ste |

asya kulaputra dharmaparyayasya udgrahanalekhanavacanad bahutaram punyam nanv eva ganganadivalukopamatmabhavaparityagasya nanv eva gamganadivalukopamalokadhatuparipurnaratnadanasya nanv eva gamganadivalukopamalpkadhatuparipurnatathagatabimbakarapanapunyaskandhasyeti 善男子,若有受持此经章句,書寫讀诵,所生胜福,甚極广大,非舍恒沙身命以為校量,亦非舍恒沙世界满中珍宝、亦非供养满於恒沙世界一切如來宝像塔廟所生之福。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §16】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:善男子,若有受持此经章句,書寫讀诵,所生胜福,甚極广大,非舍恒沙身命以為校量,亦非舍恒沙世界满中珍宝、亦非供养满於恒沙世界一切如來宝像塔廟所生之福。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):rigs kyi bu dag chos kyi rnam grans 'di 'dzin pa dan | yi ger 'dri ba dan | 'chan ba dan | klog pa'i bsod nams ni rab tu man gi lus gan ga'i klun gi bye ma snyed yons su btan ba ni de lta ma yin no || (4) 'jig rten gyi khams gan ga'i klun gi bye ma snyed yons su gan ba'i sbyin pa byin pa de ni de lta ma yin no || de bzin gsegs pa'i gzugs brnyan rin po che las byas te | 'jig rten gyi khams gan ga'i klun gi bye ma snyed yons su bkan ba'i bsod nams kyi phun po ni de lta (5) ma yin no ||

atha khalu bhagavams tasyam velayam ime gathe abhasata 爾時世尊,而说頌曰:  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §17】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:爾時世尊,而说頌曰: | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsuns so |

idam avocad bahgavan attamana avikalpaprabhasas ca bodhisattvo mahasattvah sa ca sarvavati parsat sadevamanusasuragandharvas ca loko bhagavato bhasitam abhyanandann iti 爾時世尊,说此经已,无分別照明菩萨摩訶萨,(133)及诸大会,闻佛所说,皆大欢喜,信受奉行。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §18】dun ch 1r1 - 1r133:爾時世尊,说此经已,无分別照明菩萨摩訶萨,(133)及诸大会,闻佛所说,皆大欢喜,信受奉行。 | 藏本 (kj d 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1):bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces ba' stsal nas | byan chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par mi rtog snan ba dan | thams cad dan ldan (7) pa'i 'khor de dan | lha dan | mi dan | lha ma yin dan | dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rans te | bcom ldan 'das kyis gsuns pa la mnon par bstod do ||

v: 4 om namah sarvajnaya | namo bhagavate bhaisajyaguruvaiduryaprabharajaya tathagataya (401a04)药师如來本愿功德经序 (401a05)药师如來本愿经者,致福消灾之要法也;曼殊以慈悲之力請说尊號,如來以利物之心盛陳功业;十二大愿彰因行之弘遠,七宝庄严顯果德之純净;憶念稱名則众苦咸脫,祈請供养則诸愿皆满;至於病士求救應死更生,王者攘灾轉禍為福;信是消百怪之神符,除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世,鹿野寺沙门慧簡已曾譯出在世流行,但以梵宋不融、文辞雜糅,致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披叶典,思遇此经验其紕謬;开皇十七年初獲一本,猶恐脫誤未敢即翻,至大业十一年復得二本,更相讎比方為揩定,遂與三藏法师達磨笈多,并大隋翻经沙门法行明則、長順海馭等,於東都洛水南上林園翻经舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失,故一言出口必三覆乃書,傳度幽旨差无大過;其年十二月八日翻勘方了,仍為一卷。(401a21)所愿此经深义人人共解,彼佛名號處處遍闻,十二夜叉念佛恩而护国,七千眷屬承经力以利民,帝祚遐永,群生安樂,式貽來世序云爾。 佛说药师如來本愿经 (401a26)新翻药师经,大业十二年十二月八日,沙门慧矩等六人,於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定,诸讀诵者愿莫更疑,得罪不輕。  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】t. 449 404c13-401a26 - 401b20-24:(401a04)药师如來本愿功德经序 (401a05)药师如來本愿经者,致福消灾之要法也;曼殊以慈悲之力請说尊號,如來以利物之心盛陳功业;十二大愿彰因行之弘遠,七宝庄严顯果德之純净;憶念稱名則众苦咸脫,祈請供养則诸愿皆满;至於病士求救應死更生,王者攘灾轉禍為福;信是消百怪之神符,除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世,鹿野寺沙门慧簡已曾譯出在世流行,但以梵宋不融、文辞雜糅,致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披叶典,思遇此经验其紕謬;开皇十七年初獲一本,猶恐脫誤未敢即翻,至大业十一年復得二本,更相讎比方為揩定,遂與三藏法师達磨笈多,并大隋翻经沙门法行明則、長順海馭等,於東都洛水南上林園翻经舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失,故一言出口必三覆乃書,傳度幽旨差无大過;其年十二月八日翻勘方了,仍為一卷。(401a21)所愿此经深义人人共解,彼佛名號處處遍闻,十二夜叉念佛恩而护国,七千眷屬承经力以利民,帝祚遐永,群生安樂,式貽來世序云爾。 佛说药师如來本愿经 (401a26)新翻药师经,大业十二年十二月八日,沙门慧矩等六人,於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定,诸讀诵者愿莫更疑,得罪不輕。 | 藏本 (kj d 274a2 - 274b2-4):(2)sans rgyas dan byan chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo ||

atha khalu bhagavan bhaisajyarajaya bodhisattvaya mahasattvaya sadhukaramadat sadhu sadhu bhaisajyaraja, sattvanam arthah krtah .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §6】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
atha khalu pradanasuro bodhisattvo mahasattvo bhagavantam etad avocat .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §7】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

234,1) atha khalu pradanasuro bodhisattvo mahasattvas tasyam velayam imani dharanimantrapadani bhasate sma .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §8】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

jvale mahajvale ukke tukke mukke ade adavati nrtye nrtyavati ittini vittini cittini nrtyani nrtyavati svaha .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §9】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

imani bhagavan dharanipadani ganganadivalikasamais tathagatair arhadbhih samyaksambuddhair bhasitani, anumoditani ca .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §10】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
atha khalu vaisravano maharajo bhagavantam etad avocat .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §11】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
atte tatte natte vanatte anade nadi kunadi svaha .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

ebhir bhagavan dharanipadaistesam dharmabhanakanam pudgalanam raksam karomi, yojanasataccaham tesam kulaputranam kuladuhitrnam ca evamrupanam sutrantadharakanam raksa krta bhavisyati, svastyayanam krtam bhavisyati .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §13】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

atha khalu virudhako maharajo tasyam eva parsadi samnipatito ’bhut samnisannas ca kumbhandakotinayutasatasahasraih parivrtah puraskrtah .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §14】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
agane gane gauri gandhari candali matangi pukkasi samkule vrusali sisi svaha .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §15】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
imani tani bhagavan dharanimantrapadani, yani dvacatvarimsadbhir buddhakotibhir bhasitani .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §16】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

atha khalu lamba ca nama raksasi vilamba ca nama raksasi kutadanti ca nama raksasi puspadanti ca nama raksasi makutadanti ca nama raksasi kesini ca nama raksasi acala ca nama raksasi maladhari ca nama raksasi kunti ca nama raksasi sarvasattvojohari ca nama raksasi hariti ca nama raksasi saputraparivara etah sarva raksasyo yena bhagavamstenopasamkrantah .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §17】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

atha khalu tah sarva raksasya ekasvarena samam samgitya bhagavata imani dharanimantrapadani prayacchanti sma .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §18】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

imam sirsam samaruhya ma kascid drohi bhavatu dharmabhanakanam yakso va raksaso va preto va pisaco va putano va krtyo va vetalo va kumbhando va stabdho va omarako va ostarako va apasmarako va yaksakrtyo va amanusyakrtyo va manusyakrtyo va ekahiko va dvaitiyako va traitiyako va caturthako va nityajvaro va visamajvaro va .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §19】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
atha khalu ta raksasya evasvarena samam samgitya bhagavantam abhir gathabhir adhyabhasanta .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §20】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
saptadhasya sphutenmurdha arjakasyeva manjari | ya imam mantra srutva vai atikrameddharmabhanakam .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §21】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
ya gatirmatrghatinam pitrghatina ya gatih | tam gatim pratigacchedyo dharmabhanakamatikramet .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §22】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
ya gatistilapidanam tilakutanam ca ya gatih | tam gatim pratigacchedyo dharmabhanakamatikramet .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §23】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
ya gatistulakutanam kamsyakutana ya gatih | tam gatim pratigacchedyo dharmabhanakamatikramet .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §24】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

evamuktva tah kuntipramukha raksasyo bhagavantam etaducuh - vayam api bhagavamstesam evamrupanam dharmabhanakanam raksam karisyamah, svastyayanam dandapariharam visadusanam karisyama iti .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §25】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

asmin khalu punar dharaniparivarte nirdisyamane astasastinam pranisahasranam anutpattikadharmaksantipratilabho ’bhut .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §26】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.
iti srisaddharmapundarike dharmaparyaye dharaniparivarto namaikavimsatimah .  【奥斯陆多本对勘 §27】t.263, dharmaraksa 竺法护, 286 a.d., p. 63a6:. | 藏本 (1100 a.d.? kj mdo sde ja 16a7):.

tadyatha   即说咒曰:
om bhrum bhrum bhrum sodhaya sodhaya visodhaya visodhaya asamasamantavabhasaspharanagatigaganasvabhavavisuddhe   嗡!再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印,再三请净除、涤荡清净!再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障!无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空·自性·最极清净
abhisincantu mam sarvatathagatah sugatavaravacanamrtabhisekair mahamudramantrapadaih   愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶!于我,诸一切如来,真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满,以诸大手印真言章句
om ahara ahara mama ayuhsamdharani sodhaya visodhaya usnisavijayaparisuddhe svaha   嗡!再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养!我之(行者所有),寿命擎尊,请净除、涤荡清净!请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障!佛顶肉髻相·最胜尊胜·圆满清净,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

desayatra bhagavan prajna paramitam svalpaksaram mahapunyayasya sravana matrena sarva satvamna sarva karma caranani ksapayisyanti   境凡于何处,出有坏,般若、超越妙慧,波罗蜜多(度彼岸、究竟圆满),渺小妙语,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,听闻,以惟,一切、普皆遍满,一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说,一切、普皆遍满,事,一切杂罗南,造作离相·六度满行清净·第一义谛
niyamtraca bodhi parayanam bhavisyati   离名相假立·一乘如实之道·真如实际,菩提、无上正觉,他人趣往,当
yeca satvamant sadhanetyut vatesam ca vighnena mantram sigdheranniti   一乘如实之道·妙行迁变空,一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说,成办悉地·一切诸谛圆满,风息轴以及以障碍、毗那夜迦魔障,真言,一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·法界总持任持
athakhalu bhaga vannaryava lokitesvaraya bodhisatvaya ma   尔时诚然,才,最上真言离言说·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢,向随一趣往自在主,向菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性)

v: raya samyakkam buddhaya   清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道,权利之后,向佛陀、觉者
bodhi pratisthayayati   菩提、无上正觉,稳定·出·戒精进
om ah hu sugatavajatusyahoh svaha   嗡!语金刚种子字(一切法本不生清净妙语),金刚怒王种子字(摧伏魔障),欢喜悦泽·一切诸谛圆满,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
ita buddha bhaddara kasya nama dharani samaptah   趣往、途径,佛陀、觉者,破有相福德光·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢,谁,名为、号曰,陀罗尼、总持(总一切法、持无量义),三磨钵耽
om namo buddhaya   嗡(三身总持圣音)!归命,向佛陀、觉者
om namo bhagavate arya sripadamottama tathagata yarhate samyakkam buddhaya   嗡!归命,向世尊(薄伽梵)致敬,圣、尊贵圣者,吉祥·秋天·本刹·最上,如来(乘如实道来成正觉),一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐,权利之后,向佛陀、觉者
tadyatha   即说咒曰:
om padme padme padmodbhave sukhavati managachanna svaha   嗡!再三莲华(出淤泥而不染清净心)尊,莲华氏族,极乐世界,无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行趣入,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
iti gathadvayamkaragata suddharta astottarasatam jappa etyo prasuddha bhavanita   如是(结句印定),孤起·无二·偈子赞叹·去,总持任持·一切诸谛圆满,八·无上·百,生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛,真如实际·一乘如实之道,转载真实,星宿·一样·趣往
iti arya sripadmott   如是(结句印定),圣、尊贵圣者,吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息

entries.m: 圣观自在菩萨 / 准提佛母 哥廷根大学 gretil / 尼泊尔 dsbc 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (karandavyuha) gretil 梵文佛典库 (bsu019_u.htm) · 汉译对勘:t20n1050 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 gretil 梵语原典档案「bsu019_u.htm」(共 725 行,完整提取核心真言与经句共 58 句)。系统已自动将其原始 iast 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (ipa) 及摩多轻重音律。
v: om namo ratnatrayaya   嗡(三身总持圣音)!归命,向佛法僧三宝
atha sarvanivaranaviskambhi aha - kena prakarena bhagavan? bhagavanaha - bhutapurvam kulaputra vipasyi   尔时、次复吉祥启白,除诸障,如是宣说、佛言,造作离相·离名相假立,以部,出有坏,世尊如是宣说,古昔,善男子,胜观
nama tathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddho loka udapadi vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavidanuttarah purusadamyasarathih sasta devanam   名为、号曰,如来,应供、阿罗汉,正等觉,世间、世界,净水尊足,明行足,善逝,世间解无上,调御丈夫,天人师,诸天人、诸天护法之

ca manusyanam ca buddho bhagavan / tena kalena tena samayenaham sarvanivarananiskambhin sugandhamukho   左字门(妙行迁变空(carya)·本不生体性),诸人之以及觉者,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,借由彼力、以是因缘,以时,借由彼力、以是因缘,三昧耶·勇健·如是宣说,一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说,好香面门
nama vanikputro 'bhuvam / tada me sruta vipasyinastathagatasya sakasadaryavalokitesvarasya gunodbhavana   名为、号曰,商人子,破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧,彼时,于我、为我,闻,毗卢尸佛·故乡·他·来之,一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·本性寂静止息,功德应作

tadapyatikramya sikhi nama tathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddho babhuva vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavidanuttarah purusadamyasarathih sasta   真如实际·施度调伏·第一义谛,孔雀,名为、号曰,如来,应供、阿罗汉,正等觉,解脱系缚大力·破有相福德光·最上真言离言说,明行足,善逝,世间解无上,调御丈夫,天人师
devanam ca manusyanam ca buddho bhagavan / tena kalena tena samayenaham sarvanivaranaviskambhin   诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,借由彼力、以是因缘,以时,借由彼力、以是因缘,三昧耶·勇健·如是宣说,除一切盖障菩萨

danasuro nama bodhisattvo mahasattvo 'bhuvam / tasya sikhinastathagatasya sakasadavalokitesvarasya bodhisattvasya mahasatvasya gunodbhavana   布施勇猛,名为、号曰,菩提萨埵,大菩萨,破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧,彼之、其(属格),尸弃佛·故乡·他·来之,融通·望·智火·随一·趣往·自在主,菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情)之,摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)之,功德应作
sruta   闻

atha sa balirasurendro yajnabhumerniskrantah sariracintamapede - data balirudarayajnamupasya / kaladanasya dattasya bandhanameva   尔时、次复吉祥启白,彼、此尊(阳性主格),施食·阿修罗·印达罗,一乘如实之道·生起不可得·尊胜·圣智通达,身躯·思·是的·净水·此处尊,作施,施食·广大崇高·祭祠·常勤,时布施,施度调伏·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满,缚唯
labdham / namo 'stu devaya / yathaiva karta sarta sa nitva patalamupasthapitah   离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持,归命,愿得成就、当如是,向天人、诸天护法,一乘如实之道·无住安立·最上真言离言说,部门、定异,一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际,彼、此尊(阳性主格),领导、指导已,陨·严·愈加·置
santahpuraparivarah / akhyatam hi maya bhagavan - bhutapurvam kuruksetre maya danam dattam   一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际,宣,诚然、因为、实乃,由我(具格:如是我闻),出有坏,古昔,刹土尊,由我(具格:如是我闻),布施,施度调伏·真如实际
tasyaitatkarmaphalamanubhavami / tatha trata bhavahi me bhagavannatha, na bhuyo duhkhamapnuyam   能作成办·真如实际,如是、亦复如是,守护,星宿运尊,于我、为我,出有坏依,不、非、无,又么,施度调伏·等虚空无碍·无我大慈三昧

atha aryavalokitesvaro balerindrasya vyakaranamanuprayacchati sma - bhavisyasi tvamasurendra srirnama tathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddho   尔时、次复吉祥启白,圣观自在菩萨,解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢,记别·日复一日·与摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),当有汝即是,汝·阿修罗·因陀逻,吉祥名为,如来,应供、阿罗汉,正等觉
vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavidanuttarah purusadamyasarathih sasta devanam ca manusyanam ca buddho bhagavan /   明行足,善逝,世间解无上,调御丈夫,天人师,诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵
sarve te 'sura vaineya bhavisyanti / tatra tava buddhaksetre na ragasabdo na   一切、普皆遍满尊,向汝、彼等,阿修罗(非天),老成,诸尊未来世、当头,于彼处、其中,汝之、圣尊之,佛土,不、非、无,贪染音,不、非、无
dvesasabdo na mohasabdo bhavisyati / sadaksari mahavidya labdhalabha bhavisyati / tena tasya   瞋恚音,不、非、无,愚痴音,当,六字大明咒,大明咒、大明王母,离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持,当,借由彼力、以是因缘,彼之、其(属格)
dharmadaksina upanamita / satasahasramulyam muktaharamupanamitam maulikundalam ca nanaratnasamuccitamupanamitam ca   自性左面,愈加哩溜歪斜,百千値,已解脱·如是宣说·此边·愈加·哩溜歪斜,无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·造作离相以及高显超胜·离名相假立以及
sadaksarimahavidyamahatmyavarnanam trtiyam prakaranam   六字大明咒·大明咒·自在·显色·管保,第三,极所作

athamitabhasya tathagatarhatah samyaksambuddhasya avalokitesvarasya bodhisattvasya mahasattvasya lambikarutena svarena nirghosenarocayati - pasya kulaputra   尔时阿弥陀佛之,如来堪敬,正等正觉、正遍知之,观自在菩萨(观世音)之,菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情)之,摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)之,以俱枳罗以及以音词,离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·破暗合集,第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道,善男子

ayam padmottamastathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddhah sadaksarimahavidyayah karanenanekalokadhatukotiniyutasatasahasrani paribhramitah / dadasva kulaputra sadaksarim mahavidyam   此尊、此法,第一义谛·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧,应供、阿罗汉,正等觉,六字大明咒大明咒,因·勇健·多·界境·魔爪·那由他·一切百千,般·漂·趣往,施予自,善男子,六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相,大明咒、大明王母

aupabhogikah samsarasya naimittikah prajamandalasyotpadikah / ye ca kulaputrah sadaksarim mahavidyarajnim janante, na   第一义谛·破有相福德光·妙行趣入,轮廻之,诸相士,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜,凡彼等诸有情以及诸善男子,六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·真如实际,不、非、无
ca te ragena dvesena mohena samlipyante / yatha jambunadasya suvarnasya na sajjate   左字门(妙行迁变空(carya)·本不生体性),向汝、彼等,以贪染、赤红妙爱染,以瞋恚、怨憎忿恨,以愚痴、无明迷妄,向桑·诬蔑·假定今日·汝,犹如、如...所说,种类黄金、黄金之,真金、妙金色之,不、非、无,绳子事关、妥当

na dvesena na mohena samlipyate   不、非、无,以瞋恚、怨憎忿恨,不、非、无,以愚痴、无明迷妄,桑·诬蔑·拘牵尊

atha sarvanivaranaviskambhi dharmabhanakametadavocat - dadasva me sadaksarimahavidyarajnim / atha sa dharmabhanakah samcintya   尔时、次复吉祥启白,除诸障,正法·种类戏剧·之后·此·宣说,施予自,于我、为我,广大殊胜·六度满行清净,尔时、次复吉祥启白,彼、此尊(阳性主格),说法者,应思

sadaksarim mahavidyarajnim / ayam bodhisattvabhuto 'nekaduskarabhiyuktah / punah sa dharmabhanakah samcintayati sma   六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,此尊、此法,菩提萨埵鬼,多·艰苦任务·精勤,复次、再三,彼、此尊(阳性主格),说法者,桑·认为·不是苦行人,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性)

padmasriyalamkrtam sariram / sa tadrsam rupam drstva sarvanivaranaviskambhinam bodhisattvametadavocat - anujnataste kulaputra   莲华·广大光华·严,躯,彼、此尊(阳性主格),这样一样、这样一块,色,施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障,一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说,菩提·心力·此·宣说,向圣智以此汝,善男子
avalokitesvarena bodhisattvena sadaksarim mahavidyarajnim   以观自在菩萨(观世音),以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧

atha sa dharmabhanakastasyaitadavocat - ekasyaksarasyapi na bhavati daksina, prageva sadaksarimahavidyayah / na   尔时、次复吉祥启白,彼、此尊(阳性主格),持守摄受·法界总持任持,造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道,不、非、无,成办、生起、安住,南,原来、何为,广大殊胜·六度满行清净,不、非、无

vaineyasca tvam kulaputra / tena tasya satasahasramulyamuktaharamupanamitam / sa kathayati - kulaputra,   老成及汝、圣尊您,善男子,借由彼力、以是因缘,彼之、其(属格),百千·値·已解脱·如是宣说·此边·愈加·哩溜歪斜,彼、此尊(阳性主格),讲话、连通,善男子
madvacanena sakyamunestathagatasyarhatah samyaksambuddhasyopanamayitavyam   以泡沫言,本性寂静止息·造作离相·一乘如实之道,觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满

evam mahesvaro devaputro gatva avalokitesvarasya stotravisesam krtva tusnimbhavena vyavasthitah / atha avalokitesvarastametadavocat   如是、如此,大自在,天子,趣往已,观自在菩萨(观世音)之,赞叹异,既作已、行持已,以悄悄物,不是连词,尔时、次复吉祥启白,最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相
- kim karanam tvam kulaputra tusnimbhavena vyavasthitah? atha mahesvaro devaputrastametadavocat - dadasva   迦字门(造作离相(karya)·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持),作,汝、圣尊您,善男子,以悄悄物,不是连词,尔时、次复吉祥启白,大自在,施度调伏·最上真言离言说·第一义谛,施予自

/ om namo ganapataye svaha / om ganesvaraya svaha / om ganadhipataye   嗡!归命,向誐那钵底,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!嗡!向海会众自在主,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!嗡!向海会众控制器
svaha / om ganapatipujitaya svaha / om suru suru svaha / om   圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!嗡!向誐那钵底所恭敬,自如是宣说,嗡!再三甘露妙流普润群生(素噜),圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!嗡!
turu turu svaha / om muru muru svaha / idam ananda ganapatihrdayani   再三迅疾度脱一切危厄(都噜),圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!嗡!再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚(亩噜),圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!此、此妙法,阿难,誐那钵底一切心
yah kascit kulaputro va kuladuhita va bhiksur va bhiksuni va upasako va   凡彼...者,任何一人、或有众生,善男子,或、抑或,善女人,或、抑或,比丘,或、抑或,比丘尼,或、抑或,近事男,或、抑或
upasika va / yah kascit karyam alabhate mantrasadhanam va triratnapujam va desantaragamanam   近事女,或、抑或,凡彼...者,任何一人、或有众生,果,向衍伸星宿汝,真言修习,或、抑或,三·珍宝·供养,或、抑或,行脚海外

va rajakulagamanam va antardhanam va tena buddhabhagavatam pujam krtva aryaganapatihrdayam saptavaranucarayitavyam sarvakaryani   或、抑或,王宫行,或、抑或,灭,或、抑或,借由彼力、以是因缘,佛陀·才·鸣呼,供,既作已、行持已,圣·誐那钵底·心,一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·真如实际,一切一切果

tasya sidhyante natra samsayah / sarvakalikalahamardamatsaresu nityam samatavyam sarvaprasamam gacchati / dinedine   彼之、其(属格),向驱除假定今日汝,离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢,庄严言辞凡彼...者,于诸一切·罪垢·鬪·调伏摧碾一切恶障·勿·爬行中,常恒、永不间断,息勇健,一切轻安,行,施度调伏·离名相假立

kalpam utthaya sarvasaptavaranucarayitavyam mahasaubhage bhavisyati / rajakulagamanakale mahaprasado bhavisyanti / srutidharo bhavisyati   劫波,立起,一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说,酒席·那个·分尊,当,王宫·行·时尊,大房,诸尊未来世、当头,闻请执持,当
/ na casya kaye mahavyadhayo bhavisyanti / na kascid eva tarapradaksino 'vataram   不、非、无,妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道,身、佛身法身尊,大·猎人·凡彼圣尊,诸尊未来世、当头,不、非、无,造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空,唯、正是、决定,星右遶,入

lapsyate bhrngo 'vataram lapsyati na casya bodhicittottaraya bhavisyanti / jatau jatau jatismaro   离一切相无相·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满,破有相福德光·支分寂静·妙行趣入,入,离一切相无相·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满,不、非、无,妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道,菩提心·无上·即是,诸尊未来世、当头,再三生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际,生祈请忆念本誓

sarvavati parsat sadevamanusasuragarudagandharvas ca loko bhagavato bhasitam abhyanandann iti   具足湖或,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净,彼·天人·人道·阿修罗·迦楼罗·香·踊跃以及世间、世界,以世尊此,妙语、语言,破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立,如是(结句印定)

v: grahamatrkanamadharani aryagrahamatrka nama dharani om namo bhagavatyai aryagrahamatrkayai / evam maya srutam   曜执·摩怛理迦·名为·陀罗尼,圣·曜执·摩怛理迦,名为、号曰,陀罗尼、总持(总一切法、持无量义),嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入,如是、如此,由我(具格:如是我闻),闻

ekasmin samaye bhagavan adakavatyam mahanagaryam anekadevanagayaksaraksasagandharvasuragarudakinnaramahoragapasmaradityasomangarabudhabrhaspatisukrasaniscararahuketvadibhis castavimsatinaksatradibhih stuyamano mahavajrasamayalankaravyuhadhisthanadhisthite simhasane viharati sma   一时,向平,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,息灭诤怨·造作离相·最上真言离言说,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,持守摄受·广大殊胜·妙行流布·离名相假立,妙行迁变空·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障,一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·一乘如实之道,大·金刚·中间·上首·此边·庄严·加持·所加持,师子座尊,一切,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性)
/ anekair bodhisattvasahasraih sardham / tadyatha - vajrapanina ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   离名相假立·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢,以诸菩提萨埵千,俱,即说咒曰:以金刚手菩萨(执金刚秘密主)以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ vajracandena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / vajrasenena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   以金刚威猛以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),金刚·部·勇健以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ vajravinayakena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / vajracapahastena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   以金刚毗那夜迦以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以金刚宝弓手以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ vajravikurvitena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / vajradhipatina ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   以金刚神变以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以金刚控制器以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)

/ vajralankarena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / vajravikramena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以金刚超以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ jyotivajrena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / avalokitesvarena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   以打败正勤金刚以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以观自在菩萨(观世音)以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)

/ samantabhadrena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / samantavalokitesvarena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   以普贤菩萨(遍吉)以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以普遍观自在菩萨以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ lokasriya ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / padmaketuna ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   世间广大光华以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以莲华光明幢以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ ratnaketuna ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / vikasitavaktrena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   以宝顶以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以花开面目以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ padmagarbhena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / padmanetrena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   以莲华藏以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以莲华眼以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)
/ manjusriya ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena / maitreyena ca nama bodhisattvena mahasattvena   玅广大光华以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以弥勒菩萨(慈氏尊)以及名为、号曰,以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)

/ evam pramukhair bodhisattvair mahasattvaih satasahasraih sardham parivrtah puraskrto bhagavan dharmam desayati   如是、如此,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧,菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力,以诸摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),以诸百千,俱,围绕,立行面前,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,正法、诸法实相,宣说
sma / adau kalyanam madhye kalyanam paryavasane kalyanam svartham suvyanjanam kevalam paripurnam   摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),施度调伏,善,中尊,善,截止、究竟尊,善,义善,语善,纯一无杂,圆满

parisuddhaparyavadatam brahmacaryam samprakasayati sma / cintamanimahavyuhalankaram nama dharmaparyayam desayati sma / atha   圆满清净皆消除,梵行,桑·光明·戒精进,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),广大殊胜·妙行迁变空,名为、号曰,法门,宣说,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),尔时、次复吉祥启白

khalu vajrapanir bodhisattvo mahasattvas tat parsanmandalam avalokyasanad utthaya svarddhyadhisthanena bhagavantam anekasatasahasram pradaksinikrtya   诚然、确实,金刚手,菩提萨埵,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,彼、真如彼岸,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净,最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相,立起,一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·施度调伏,若衍底,多百千,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏

pranamya purato nisadya sagarvena paryankam abhujya lilaya tat parsanmandalam avalokya vajranjali svahrdaye   恭敬稽首顶礼已,阵地、之前,离名相假立·六度满行清净·施度调伏,以贡高、自傲,牀,弯曲,以戏剧、体育,彼、真如彼岸,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净,鸿毛通常,最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢,向自心髓

pratisthapya bhagavantam etad avocat / grahas ca bhagavann ugranugrarupas ca raudraraudrarupas ca   第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际,若衍底,此、此事,宣说、开示教敕,妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐以及破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说,妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立以及清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·第一义谛以及

krurakrurarupas ca sattvan vihethayanti / kesancit pranam apaharanti kesancid upadravas ca kurvanti   造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛以及有情、众生、勇猛心,最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立,造作离相·六度满行清净·圣智通达,入息,诸尊除断、摧灭,造作离相·六度满行清净·圣智通达,第一义谛·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢以及成办作持·造作离相

kesancid ojoharams ca kurvanti kesancid dravyam apaharanti kesancid dirghayussattvanam alpayusam kurvanti /   造作离相·六度满行清净·圣智通达,诸掠夺大力以及成办作持·造作离相,造作离相·六度满行清净·圣智通达,物,诸尊除断、摧灭,造作离相·六度满行清净·圣智通达,施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·破暗合集,离一切相无相·第一义谛·一乘如实之道,成办作持·造作离相

evam sarvasattvanam upadravena vahayanti / tad desayatu bhagavan dharmaparyayam yena sarvasattvanam sarvopadravebhyo   如是、如此,诸一切众生、普皆有情之,以灾横、恼害横祸,报刊诸尊此处,彼、如是真实,施度调伏·本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道,出有坏,法门,借由彼因缘,诸一切众生、普皆有情之,一切·灾横·富人
raksa bhavisyati / bhagavan aha - sadhu sadhu vajrapane yas tvam sarvasattvanam   守护、结界护念,当,世尊、出有坏薄伽梵,如是宣说、佛言,再三萨,最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢,娑字门(一切诸谛圆满(sarvasatya)·本不生体性),汝、圣尊您,诸一切众生、普皆有情之

arthaya hitaya sukhaya krpacittam utpadya mahaguhyatiguhyataram tathagatam samyaksambuddham pariprcchasi / tac chrnu   向义利、所求善愿、胜义,向利,向乐,慈悲心,迸饭食,大·密·太·被覆·如何哪些,如来(乘如实道来成正觉),正等正觉、正遍知,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空,左字门(妙行迁变空(carya)·本不生体性),离覆障清凉·离诸诤论无诤
sadhu ca susthu ca manasi kuru bhasisye 'ham te / grahanam ugrarupanam   萨以及极善以及事关,祈请成办羯磨事业(俱噜),宣说演畅·破有相福德光,我、真我自性,向汝、彼等,诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障之,诸可怕相貌之

kruratibhisanamukhanam mahaguhyatiguhyataram divyapujam argham ca japan ca dhupan ca - yathanuvarnabhedena yatha   凶恶·比较可怕·诸面门,大·密·太·被覆·如何哪些,天妙供,功德以及生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·圣智通达以及法界总持任持·第一义谛·圣智通达以及以犹如·日复一日·显色·异生性,犹如、如...所说

om mune mune mahamunaye svaha / om same same mahasame raksa raksa mam sarvasattvanamca sarvapapaprasamane svaha   嗡!再三无我大慈三昧·离名相假立,向大牟尼尊(释迦世尊),圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!嗡!再三平尊,大平尊,祈请再三拥护、守护于我,一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说,一切·罪业·转载·会议,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

namah suparikirttita nama dheyaya tathagataya / namah samantavabhasavijitasamgramasriye tathagataya / namah indraketudhvajasriye   归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·名为、号曰·驮都、摇摆·如来即是·普现·驮都·圣众·广大光华尊·如来(乘如实道来成正觉)·因陀逻·光明幢·宝幢·广大光华尊!

tathagataya arhate samyaksambuddhaya / namo vikrantagamine tathagatayarhate samyaksambuddhaya / namo buddhaya namo   向如来(乘如实道来成正觉),向应供(阿罗汉)致敬,向权利随着佛陀,归命,最上真言离言说·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢,如来·出·堪敬尊,向权利随着佛陀,归命,向佛陀、觉者,至心归命礼!
dharmaya namah samghaya / namo atitanagata pratyutpannebhyo buddhebhyo bhagavadbhyah   向正法、诸法实相,归命,向圣僧伽、清净海众,归命,过去末,现在时富人,佛陀富人,向诸才宣说
tadyatha   即说咒曰:

smrtivarddhani gativarddhani dhrtivarddhani prajnavarddhani pratibhanavarddhani dhyanavarddhani samaryavarddhani sarvabodhipaksadharmmavarddhani sakalaburddhadharmaparipuniye svaha   正念兴盛尊,趣向兴盛尊,想兴盛尊,般若兴盛尊,辩才兴盛尊,禅那兴盛尊,三末耶兴盛尊,一切·菩提·宗法·兴盛尊,持守摄受·一切诸谛圆满,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

namo ratnatrayaya namo aryavalokitesvaraya bodhisattvaya mahasattvaya mahakarunikaya / ebhyo namaskrtva idamaryavalokitesvaramukhongirnamamoghapasarajannama hrdayam   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情)·摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·顶礼敬拜已·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·心!

tathagata sammukhabhasitam mahata parsata madhye ahamidanimmavarttayisye sidhyantu me mantrapada sarvvakaryani   如来(乘如实道来成正觉),当面妙语,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净,中尊,因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏,愿诸真言章句悉皆成就,于我、为我,真言章句、密咒句义,一切一切果
om cara cara ciri ciri curu curu mara mara miri miri muru   嗡!再三行持妙道、周游救护(左啰),再三久远常恒护持不退(唧哩),再三妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢,再三临危、死厄,再三慈愍覆护一切有情(弭哩),无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢
muru mahakarunika / sara sara siri siri suru suru curu curu ciri   无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢,广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧,再三流注周遍、速行护念(萨啰),再三吉祥福德流注庄严(悉哩,再三一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢,再三妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢,久远常恒护持不退(唧哩)
ciri viri viri piri piri miri miri mahapadahasta / kala kala kili   久远常恒护持不退(唧哩),再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢,再三第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢,再三慈愍覆护一切有情(弭哩),乐趣·灾异·手,再三尊手,金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军(吉栗)
kili kulu kulu mahasuddhasatva / buddhaya buddhaya bodha bodha bodhi bodhi bodhaya   金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军(吉栗),再三造作离相·离一切相无相,大清净尊者,再三佛陀、觉者,再三悟,再三菩提、无上正觉,请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智!
bodhaya kana kana kini kini kunu kunu paramasuddhasattva / kara kara kiri   请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智!再三赤红,再三痕迹尊,再三造作离相·离诸诤论无诤,最胜清净尊者,再三掌,舒散光明、散布吉祥!(源自 √kr)
kiri kuru kuru mahasthamaprapta   舒散光明、散布吉祥!(源自 √kr),再三成办作持·造作离相,大势至
cala cala samcala samcala vicala vicala etata etata bhara bhara bhiri bhiri bhuru bhuru tara tara   再三震动警觉、破除昏沉(左罗),再三索索,再三闢震动警觉,再三断除憍慢执障,再三方位、战斗,再三无畏威神震伏魔怨(毗利),再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢,再三弯曲、超群

v: dharmesvajnanam   持守摄受·圣智了知·归命敬礼·法界总持任持
atite 'jnanam   过去尊,黑闇、无明
anagate 'jnanam   末尊,黑闇、无明
pratyutpanne 'jnanam   现在时,黑闇、无明
atitanagatapratyutpannesu dharmesvajnanam   于诸过去末现在时,持守摄受·圣智了知·归命敬礼·法界总持任持
sat su va sparsayatanesu yathabhutamajnanamadarsanamanabhisamayastamah sammoho 'vidyandhakaram   六(六度,娑字门(一切诸谛圆满(sarvasatya)·损减除灭忧苦),或、抑或,于诸触十二处中,圣智了知·归命敬礼·一乘如实之道,三么多加法,黑闇暗
iyamucyate 'vidyeti   此处·解放·拘牵尊,黑闇瘟疫

v: om namah sarvajnaya   嗡(三身总持圣音)!归命,向一切智
sudurlabham sugatavarasya darsanam namo 'stu te buddha mahanubhavo   报刊往外难得,善逝殊胜,观照,归命,愿得成就、当如是,向汝、彼等,佛陀、觉者,乐趣体面
namo 'stu te dharmamayam mahamune namo 'stu te klesavicaksanaryam   归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·正法过去·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧·愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·烦恼·贤·圣!
namo 'stu te sarvajarapramoksanat namo 'stu te marganidarsanaryam   归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·一切·老苦·从弃捨·愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·场地·无指示·圣!
namo 'stu te margapathasya darsakam namo 'stu te bodhipathasya darsakam   归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·圣道路·现见、观众·愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·菩提路·现见、观众!
namo 'stu te buddha mahanubhava prakasitam sutramidam niruttaram   归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·佛陀、觉者·乐趣体面·转载·有形·趣往·迫切往外·蓝·此·无上!
namo 'stu te buddha mahanubhava prakasitam sutramidam tvaya subham   归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·佛陀、觉者·乐趣体面·转载·有形·趣往·界线此·由汝圣尊·清净吉祥、善妙庄严!

v: ca / vajrarcihsrivatsalamkaragarbhena ca / jyotirjvalanarcihsrigarbhena ca / naksatrarajaprabhavabhasagarbhena ca / gaganakosanavaranajnanagarbhena   左字门(妙行迁变空(carya)·本不生体性),吉祥庄严·最上真言离言说以及炽燃放光·吉祥庄严·生起不可得·尊胜以及以大王星星·威·光净·童子以及以虚空·库·成就·智藏

ca / anavaranasvaramandalamadhuranirghosagarbhena ca / dharanimukhasarvajagatpranidhisamdharanagarbhena ca / sagaravyuhagarbhena ca / merusrigarbhena   左字门(妙行迁变空(carya)·本不生体性),以成就·音词·曼荼罗·甘·责任·藏以及以陀罗尼·面门·一切·动人·即时·擎·藏以及以大海庄严藏以及以须弥山王功德藏
ca / sarvagunavisuddhigarbhena ca / tathagatasrigarbhena ca / buddhasrigarbhena ca / vimukticandrena   左字门(妙行迁变空(carya)·本不生体性),以一切·功德·净·藏以及以如来功德藏以及以佛陀功德藏以及以解脱月
ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena / evampramukhair   左字门(妙行迁变空(carya)·本不生体性),以菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),以摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),最上真言离言说·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢

sa evam jnanabaladhanapraptah sarvasattvasapekso buddhajnanabhilasi purvantaparantam sarvasamskaragatasya pratyaveksate yatha purvantato 'vidyabhavatrsnaprasrtanam sattvanam   彼、此尊(阳性主格),如是、如此,智慧力·不是财物·得,一切众生依存,佛陀·圣智·欲,前边后际,一切·行·去之,观察,犹如、如...所说,圆满充盈·第一义谛,无明·愿成·爱·诸传播,诸有情、众生、勇猛心之

samsarasroto 'nuvahinam skandhalayanucchalitanam duhkhaskandho vivardhate, niratma nihsattvo nirjivo nisposo nispudgala atmatmiyavigatah, tam   轮廻活期,日复一日·报刊·勇健,高显超胜·一切诸谛圆满,苦根,闢增长,离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际,无人,非灵魂、没电,离名相假立·六度满行清净·第一义谛,无补特伽罗,自我离,彼(宾格)
yathabhutam prajanati / yatha ca anagatasyaiva asatsammohabhilasasya vyavacchedah paryanto nihsaranam nastyasti ca,   如实,裔胄·气息·太,犹如、如...所说以及自然·宝树宝山·彼之·犹如,摧破愚痴·一切诸谛圆满,分,期,离,离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际以及
tacca yathabhutam prajanati   真如实际·妙行迁变空,如实,裔胄·气息·太
te dharanimukhi samadhisamahitagra vipula abhijna api ksetrapravesanantam   向汝、彼等,陀罗尼面门,三摩地·等引·尊,广大、宽博无量,六通,亦、虽、乃至,田·转载·定居者·无边

v: namo ratnatrayaya / namo vairocanaya tathagataya / nama aryavalokitesvaraya bodhisattvaya mahasattvaya mahakarunikaya   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·毗卢遮那佛(大日遍照如来)·如来(乘如实道来成正觉)·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情)·摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者!
/ namah atitanagatapratyutpannebhyah sarvatathagatebhyo 'rhad bhyah samyaksambuddhebhyah   归命顶礼一切过去末现在时·一切如来富人·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·施度调伏·耶字门(一乘如实之道(yana)·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入)·一切正等正觉、正遍知!
namo ratnatrayaya / nama aryavalokitesvaraya bodhisattvaya mahasattvaya / tad yatha haha haha   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情)·摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨)·彼、如是真实·犹如、如...所说·因缘空寂大乐!
/ ime tile cile bhile khile svaha / snanopasparsanavastrabhyuksipanamantrah saptajapena   怎么,芝麻尊,妙行迁变空·离一切相无相,破有相福德光·离一切相无相,硬度尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛,以七诵念
namo ratnatrayaya / nama aryavalokitesvaraya bodhisattvayamahasattvaya   归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵出摩诃萨埵!

namo ratnatrayaya / nama aryavalokitesvaraya bodhisattvaya mahasattvaya / tadyatha thiri thiri dhiri dhiri svaha / gandhapuspopanivedanamantrah   归命向佛法僧三宝,归命,向圣观自在菩萨,菩提萨埵即是,摩诃萨埵即是,即说咒曰:再三无住安立·清净离诸尘垢,再三禅定坚固总持不失(地利),圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!香·花·愈加·在于·吠陀·那么怛罗
namo ratnatrayaya / nama aryavalokitesvaraya bodhisattvaya mahasattvaya mahakarunikaya / tadyatha sade sade   归命向佛法僧三宝,归命,祈请圣观自在菩萨,向菩提萨埵(菩萨、觉有情),向摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者,即说咒曰:再三疲倦、疑悔尊
sidi sidi sudu sudu svaha / balinivedanamantra ekavimsatijapena   再三一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏,再三一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!威势·犹如·此处·那么怛罗,以二十一诵念

namo ratnatrayaya / nama aryavalokitesvarayabodhisattvaya mahasattvaya / mahakarunikaya / tadyatha yasi ddhasi   归命向佛法僧三宝,归命,向圣观自在菩萨出菩提萨埵,向摩诃萨埵(大心有情、大菩萨),向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者,即说咒曰:一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满,施度调伏·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满
cari huru icuruh suruh muruh svaha / homamantrah / anena mantrena jnatinastai(?)   经过作法,疾速拔济除障(虎噜),妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢,甘露妙流普润群生(素噜),速疾摧碎烦恼结缚(亩噜),圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!护摩供阿满多罗,以此(真言功德力),以真言、密咒(护心密语),圣智了知·生起不可得·尊胜

ragnim prajvalya dadhimadhudhrtabhyaktanamahoratrausikena ekena trimsata homah karyah / tatah karma samarabhet   清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入·离名相假立,第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜,施予饶益·广大殊胜·施度调伏,以一、唯一不二,真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息,护摩,果,由伊人、本刹,事,一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢

samayena candrasuryapradipo nama tathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddho loka udapadi vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavidanuttarah purusadamyasarathih   以三昧耶(本誓、平等契合、时际),月轮·日轮·灯,名为、号曰,如来,应供、阿罗汉,正等觉,世间、世界,净水尊足,明行足,善逝,世间解无上,调御丈夫

sa dharmam desayati sma adau kalyanam madhye kalyanam paryavasane kalyanam   彼、此尊(阳性主格),正法、诸法实相,宣说,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),施度调伏,善,中尊,善,截止、究竟尊,善

api khalu punah sariputra, bhavisyasi tvamanagate 'dhvani aprameyaih kalpairacintyairapramanairbahunam tathagatakotinayutasatasahasranam saddharmam dharayitva   亦、虽、乃至,诚然、确实,复次、再三,舍利子,当有汝即是,汝末尊,无妙音、音声,以诸无可量,造作离相·离一切相无相·第一义谛,如来·魔爪·那庾多·诸百千之,妙法,放置财物
vividham ca pujam krtva imameva bodhisattvacaryam paripurya padmaprabho nama tathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddho   各个、种种以及供,既作已、行持已,此唯,菩萨道,圆满充盈·第一义谛,华光,名为、号曰,如来,应供、阿罗汉,正等觉
loke bhavisyasi vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavidanuttarah purusadamyasarathih sasta devanam ca manusyanam ca buddho   世间、世界尊,当有汝即是,明行足,善逝,世间解无上,调御丈夫,天人师,诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者
bhagavan   世尊、出有坏薄伽梵
namo 'stu te apratima maharse devatideva kalavinkasusvara   归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·无比·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧·天中天·迦罗频迦·报刊往外·音词!
yam vyakrtah sma paramagrabodhaye namo 'stu te nayaka nantacaksuh   风大自在除障种子,包扎诸所作,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),向最胜尊菩提,归命,愿得成就、当如是,向汝、彼等,导师,离名相假立·真如实际·妙行迁变空

bhavatu / purvakarma ksapaya / mama   愿成就、愿悉吉祥,宿业,祈请从事告解,我之(行者所有)
namah sarvabuddhanam / sarvabodhisattvanamarhantanam / tadyatha om vajradhara vajradhara vajrakaya vajrabala vajrateja   归命一切没驮南,一切·菩提萨埵·气息·是的·诸一同么,即说咒曰:嗡!再三金刚总持、执金刚尊,金刚身,金刚力,金刚威光
/ hum hum / vajrapane tathagatajnam palaya / smara pratijnam / sarvavyadhim   吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢,如来命令,请护念、摄受守护!祈请忆念本誓,立宗,一切病患
sarvapapani nasaya / dehi me yathepsitam varam / mama   一切一切罪业,请除灭、遣散灾厄!请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地!于我、为我,犹如所愿,殊胜、胜愿、妙好,我之(行者所有)
namo namah sarvatathagatanam / om samkhini devi agaccha agaccha / tistha dhane   归命顶礼一切如来·三身总持圣音(法报化三身摄受)·本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·离名相假立·天女、佛母明妃尊·唯愿降临赴会!·祈请安住加持·财尊!
dhanajaye / vr vr vrddhikari / dhr dhr dhrtikari / nanavividhavesavastrayudhadharini /   向起步山羊,再三嚩字门(最上真言离言说(vak,长阶大象尊,再三驮字门(法界总持任持(dhatu,想大象尊,执持分别·各个·定居者·袨服器械

varam / samkhini svaha   殊胜、胜愿、妙好,本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·离名相假立,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om mahadevi bhime bhimamate / jaye jayavahe / yasajave tejajave / vyakaranaprapte   嗡!摩诃室利尊,作怖尊,怖畏我之,胜伏、最胜吉祥!尊,胜伏·鸿毛·呼唤圣尊叹词,称速尊,威光速尊,记别得尊
sarvasattvavalokane krpatejabahule tathagatanujnatam palaya / smara pratijnam / buddhadhisthanena dehi me varam   一切众生·鸿毛·随一·自然,造作离相·第一义谛·真如实际,如来受权,请护念、摄受守护!祈请忆念本誓,立宗,以佛陀加持,请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地!于我、为我,殊胜、胜愿、妙好
/ siddhim kuru / devi mahadevi satyavacanadevi bhime satyavacanapratisthite guhyanivasini svaha   悉地、妙成就,祈请成办羯磨事业(俱噜),天女、佛母明妃尊,摩诃室利尊,谛·言·天女,作怖尊,参半·麦·享受·无住尊,被覆·假定今日·犹如·汝即是·在于,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!

ye 'pi te matara mahamatarah lokamanucarantih; satvavihethika balimalyopaharisca / tadyatha - brahmani   凡彼等诸有情,亦、虽、乃至,向汝、彼等,勿弯曲,大·勿·诸弯曲,世间·那罗·动着·对治,一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说,施食·鬘·愈加·拿来净水及即说咒曰:解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐

jambudvipakani ratnani, tadyathamanayo mukta vaiduryasankhasilapravalarajatajatarupamasmagarbho musaragalvo lohitika daksinavartah etani ca   生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力,一切珍宝、摩尼宝,即说咒曰·称计粒子·凡彼圣尊,真珠,最上真言离言说·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢,无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢,红宝石,施度调伏·造作离相·六度满行清净,一切长柄、本刹以及

v: evam namo 'titanagatapratyutpannebhyah sambuddhebhyah   如是、如此,归命,向诸过去末现在时,向诸三藐三佛陀、佛驮
katama ca mahamaudgalyayana pranidhicarya   哪些哪些以及目犍连,即时所行
ito mahamaudgalyayana aparimita asamkhyeya kalpa yam sakyamunir nama tathagato 'rham samyaksambuddho loke   从此,目犍连,无限量,阿僧祇,细轨,风大自在除障种子,释迦牟尼,名为、号曰,如来,配称,正等觉,世间、世界尊
udapadi vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavid anuttarah purusadamyasarathih sasta devanam ca manusyanam ca   净水尊足,明行圆满,善逝,世间解,无上,调御丈夫,天人师,诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及
sakyamunisya khalu punah mahamaudgalyayana kapilavastum nama nagaram vistarena   本性寂静止息·造作离相·一乘如实之道,诚然、确实,复次、再三,目犍连,棕色物,名为、号曰,小邑,以广说
tadaham sresthi abhusi   彼如是宣说,长者尊,无严饰
yvagupanam krtva bodhaye pranihitam   稀饭渴饮,既作已、行持已,悟出,穿上、固定转载

ito mahamaudgalyayana aparimite asamkhyeye kalpe samitavir nama tathagato 'rham samyaksambuddho loke udapadi vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavid anuttarah purusadamyasarathih   从此,目犍连,无限量尊,阿僧祇尊,细轨尊,遭遇公然,名为、号曰,如来,配称,正等觉,世间、世界尊,净水尊足,明行足,善逝,世间解,无上,调御丈夫
evam maya srutamekasmim samaye bhagavam rajagrhe viharati sma grdhrakute parvate   如是、如此,由我(具格:如是我闻),谛听妙闻·本性寂静止息,向平,世尊、薄伽梵(具六德尊),王舍城尊,一切,摩字门(无我大慈三昧(mahamaitri)·本不生体性),灵鸟顶山尊,时节
atha khalv ayusman mahamaudgalyayano kalyam eva nivasayitva patracivaram adaya rajagrham nagaram pindaya prakrami   尔时、次复吉祥启白,嚩字门(最上真言离言说(vak,具寿,目犍连,旦,唯、正是、决定,在于·天衣·极微已,衣钵,摄取受用已,王舍城,小邑,向丸,措施、踏步尊
atha khalv ayusmato mahamaudgalyayanasya aciraprakrantasyaitat abhavat   尔时、次复吉祥启白,嚩字门(最上真言离言说(vak,以具寿此,目犍连之,妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛,无汝

atipragas tavad etarahim rajagrham nagaram pindaya caritum / yam nunaham yena suddhavasam devanikayam tenopasamkrameyam   以及及早,真如实际·最上真言离言说·施度调伏,这早晚儿,王舍城,小邑,向丸,妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢,风大自在除障种子,真实无疑如是宣说,借由彼因缘,净居天,圣众神明,借由彼力·战拏攻击·此圣女
athayusman mahamaudgalyayanah tadyathapi   即时汝等,目犍连,即说咒曰善友
ito maudgalyayana aparimite asamkhyeye kalpe ratno nama samyaksambuddho abhusi tathagato 'rham samyaksambuddho   从此,大目犍连,无限量尊,阿僧祇尊,细轨尊,珍宝、摩尼宝,名为、号曰,正等觉,无严饰,如来,配称,正等觉
vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavid anuttarah purusadamyasarathih sasta devanam ca manusyanam ca   明行圆满,善逝,世间解,无上,调御丈夫,天人师,诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及
aham tada raja cakravarti abhusi   我、真我自性,彼时,人皇,转轮圣王尊,无严饰
tato mayaitasya bhagavato ratanavato caturasiti kutagarasahasrani karitani citrani   次,过去趣往,以世尊此,摩尼宝鸣呼,八十四,楼观一切千,造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际,一切彩画
namo 'stu buddhanam namo 'rhatam   名为、号曰,愿得成就、当如是,没驮南,归命,配称救度佛母根本种子字
dasabhumikasyadi   十地·谁·元
na ca mantram prayojenti parasya dehaghatakam   不、非、无以及真言,乐趣热门,他人之,身凶手
namo 'stu te buddha anantadarsana   归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·佛陀、觉者·无边观照!

lxxv. katame dasa guna dipapradanasya. ucyate. pradipabhuto bhavati lokasya. mamsacaksur nasyati. divyacaksuh   嚩字门(最上真言离言说(vak,哪些哪些尊,十(十方,功德、殊胜妙德,灯施予,妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际,灯鬼,成办、生起、安住,世间、世界之,皮肉慧眼,散失走失戒精进,天妙目
pradurbhavati. avidyandhakaram vidhamati. jnanaloka utpadyate. kusalakusalan dharman ksipram prajnaya pratividhyati. samsare samsarato   现成办,黑闇暗,除,圣智光明,迸今日,善恶,正法、诸法实相,疾,以般若、超越妙慧,对最后展览会,轮廻尊,桑·彼·忻

namo bhagavatyai aryamahapratisarayai / namah samyaksambudhebhyah   归命顶礼世尊佛母顶礼·广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢·一切权利桑水星!
sarvarthasiddhena ca vidyadhararajena / anekavidyadhararajaparivarena   以一切义成以及以持密咒者来诣,以多·持密咒者·来诣·眷属
vajrankusya ca / vajrasankaraya ca / catuhsastibhis ca vajrahutibhih / vajrasenena ca   以金刚铁钩以及以金刚作乐以及妙行迁变空·真如实际·六度满行清净以及最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢,金刚·部·勇健以及
subahuna ca / murdhatakena ca / anekavajrakulaparivarena   以善臂以及以顶行以及以多金刚部眷属
sarvasatrun pramathnati vidyarajno hi tejasa   一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说,摧伏魔怨·第一义谛,发现物·鎚锉·了知,诚然、因为、实乃,真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满
sravakah sarvabuddhanam vidyadevyo mahabalah   诸舍罗婆迦,一切没驮南,最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道,诸大力威神、大势力尊
buddhas caiva mahatmano vidyadevyo mahabalah   觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力,以及、亦复如是(ca + eva),大自性气息,最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道,诸大力威神、大势力尊
anyas ca bahavo vidyasatvanugrahakarikah   离名相假立·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息以及解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说,明咒·有情·摄益·诸品类

om namo bhagavatyai aryamahapratisarayai   嗡!归命,向世尊佛母顶礼,广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢
namo buddhaya namo dharmaya namah samghaya   归命顶礼佛陀、觉者·正法、诸法实相·圣僧伽、清净海众!
namah sarvatathagatebhyo namah sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyo 'titanagatapratyutpannebhyo namah   归命顶礼一切如来富人·一切·佛陀·菩提萨埵·富人·过去·末·现在时·富人!
tadyatha om amrtavare vara-vara pravara visuddhe hum-hum phat-phat svaha   即说咒曰:嗡!甘露殊胜,再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好,最妙,最极清净、究竟净除尊,吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!泮吒泮吒(顿断一切魔障)!圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om amrtavilokini garbha samraksani akarsani hum hum phatphat svaha   嗡!无我大慈三昧·真如实际·最上真言离言说,藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏,守护从中尊,阿羯沙尼尊,吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!顿断魔障顿断魔障,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
aparajitahrdayam   无能胜佛母心
om vimale vipule jayavare jayavahini amrtaviraje hum hum phatphat svaha   嗡!毗磨利,广大、宽博无量尊,胜伏殊胜,尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜,甘露嚩啰阇尊,吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!顿断魔障顿断魔障,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om bhara-bhara sambhara-sambhara indriye balavisodhani hum hum phatphatru ru cale svaha   嗡!再三方位、战斗,再三桑方位,根尊,力·闢·理由,吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!妙果圆成·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢,啰字门(清净离诸尘垢(rajas)·损减除灭忧苦),震动警觉、破除昏沉(左罗)尊,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
om manidhari vajrini mahapratisare hum hum phatphat svaha   嗡!持摩尼宝珠(如意离垢宝)尊,具金刚(坚固不坏、摧破一切障)尊,大随求佛母(随愿即得大明王母)尊,吽吽(金刚不坏心印)!顿断魔障顿断魔障,圆满吉祥成就(娑嚩诃)!
upahrdayavidya   下属明咒
yaya yukto vajrakayo namastasyai namo namah   一乘如实之道,具,金刚身,向管保故乡,归命,至心归命礼!

yadutasmin satidam bhavaty asyotpadad idam utpadyate yadutavidyapratyayah samskara yavat samudayo nirodha)s ca bhavati   亦即于此之中,一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·施度调伏,破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际,一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·真如实际,此、此妙法,迸今日,亦即·无明·诸缘,行(诸行造作),乃至,集,灭谛,奢字门(本性寂静止息(santi)·本不生体性)以及成办、生起、安住

specialized12DbRecords.sanskritIast: nanu prayojanaviśeṣārthitaiva puṃsaḥ prayojanaviśeṣasaṃśayotpattihetuḥ prāgvidyata eva | tathāhi prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣāparigatamanasaḥ prathamataramevaṃ bhavatyeva, kimidamasmadadhi gataprayojanena saprayojanam ? āhosvidanyena ? kiṃ vā niṣprayojanamiti; tatsādhaka bādhakapramāṇābhāve tasya nyāyaprāptatvāt | prayojanaviśeṣapratipādakaśāstrāntaropala bdheśca | ato bhavatyeva prāgapi prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśaya iti vyarthaḥ prayojanavākyo panyāsaḥ | naitadasti | yadyapi prayojanaviśeṣārthitāpi saṃśayaviśeṣaheturbhavati | ta thāpi na sā sarveṣāṃ saṃmukhībhavati | avyutpannapuruṣārthānāṃ mūḍhadhiyāṃ keṣāṃcidasaṃmu khībhāvāt | tathāhi—mokṣaḥ paramapuruṣārthatayā siddhaḥ, atha ca santi kecidavyu tpannā ye tamapi paramapuruṣārthaṃ puruṣārthatayā na jānanti | prāgye na taṃ prārthayiṣyante te | na vā saṃmukhībhūtā prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣā prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasandehotpattihetu ryuktā, kāraṇasattādhīnatvātkāryāṇām | yadi nāma sā keṣāṃcidapi saṃmukhībhavati, tathāpyasau sādhanāntaraparityāgena pratiniyatasādhanopādānahetoḥ saṃśayaviśeṣasya heturna bhavati; sarvatra sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvena tasyāstaddhetutvena nyāyaprāptatvāt | na cai tāvanmātreṇa pravṛttiryuktā | sarvatra pravṛttiprasaṅgāt | na ca śakyaṃ kenacitsarvatra pravartti tumityataḥ phalaviśeṣārthino'pi pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahanibandhanābhāvādudāsīran | tasmātpratiniyatasādhanaparigrahahetuprayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśayotpādanāyātyantaparokṣārtha viṣayāgamapraṇayanavat phalaviśeṣārthinā pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahāyābhidhānīyameva prayo janavākyam | tathā hi tenāsyaiva śāstrasyārthaviśeṣa upadarśyate nānyasya | ato'nena pratiniyatasādhanasādhyaphalaviśeṣaviṣayaḥ saṃśayo janyate | sa ca śrotā kadācinma māyamarthaviśeṣo niṣpatsyata iti prayojanavākyopajanitāt prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayādatya ntaparokṣārthaviṣayāgamopajanitādiva saṃśayātpravarttetāpītyataḥ prayojanavākyopanyāsaḥ ||

specialized12DbRecords.subtitle: 《藥師琉璃光如來本願功德經》梵藏漢對勘
specialized12DbRecords.sanskritIast: §0-4 oṃ namaḥ sarvajñāya | namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyaguruvaiḍūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāya ||
specialized12DbRecords.chineseText: (401a04)藥師如來本願功德經序 (401a05)藥師如來本願經者，致福消災之要法也；曼殊以慈悲之力請說尊號，如來以利物之心盛陳功業；十二大願彰因行之弘遠，七寶莊嚴顯果德之純淨；憶念稱名則眾苦咸脫，祈請供養則諸願皆滿；至於病士求救應死更生，王者攘災轉禍為福；信是消百怪之神符，除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世，鹿野寺沙門慧簡已曾譯出在世流行，但以梵宋不融、文辭雜糅，致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披葉典，思遇此經驗其紕謬；開皇十七年初獲一本，猶恐脫誤未敢即翻，至大業十一年復得二本，更相讎比方為揩定，遂與三藏法師達磨笈多，并大隋翻經沙門法行明則、長順海馭等，於東都洛水南上林園翻經舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失，故一言出口必三覆乃書，傳度幽旨差無大過；其年十二月八日翻勘方了，仍為一卷。(401a21)所願此經深義人人共解，彼佛名號處處遍聞，十二夜叉念佛恩而護國，七千眷屬承經力以利民，帝祚遐永，群生安樂，式貽來世序云爾。 佛說藥師如來本願經 (401a26)新翻藥師經，大業十二年十二月八日，沙門慧矩等六人，於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定，諸讀誦者願莫更疑，得罪不輕。
